faqs.question: Is AIIMS Delhi hard to get admission in?
faqs.answer:
AIIMS Delhi offers admission for UG, PG, Doctoral and Super Speciality courses such as BSc, MSc, MD, MDS, MS, and PhD, among others. Admission to any of the course is conducted based on entrance. Therefore, candidates must  prepare for the accepted entrance exams such as NEET UG, AIIMS Paramedical Entrance Exam, INICET, Joint CSIR-UGC NET for JRF/ ICMR - JRF/ ICMR- SRF/ DBT - JRF/ NBHM screening test/ INSPIRE fellowship. 
The accepted entrance exams may vary as per the choice of course opted for. Candidates must analyse the cutoffs to learn more about the probability of qualifying for AIIMS Delhi and securing a seat. Although, every admission year is more challenging than the previous one, candidates can still make it by putting in some efforts and work on those grades.

faqs.question: What is the NEET UG Round 1 opening and closing rank for MBBS at AIIMS Delhi?
faqs.answer: NEET UG Round 1 cutoff has been released for the AIIMS Delhi MBBS course. The Opening and Closing ranks depend on the category and quota of candidates. As per the AIIMS Delhi cutoff 2024, the NEET UG Round 1 opening rank was 1 and the closing rank was 47 for the general category candidates under All India quota. Cut off are different when it comes to other categories or female candidates and even the domicile of home state. Admission to the Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) at AIIMS Delhi is based on the scores obtained in the NEET UG entrance exam, followed by the NEET UG counselling process.

college_info.intro:
All India Institute of Medical Sciences AIIMS Delhi offers various programmes at several levels, such as UG, PG, PhD, etc. The programmes are offered across various fields, including Medicine, Nursing, Medical, and others. MBBS is the flagship programme of AIIMS Delhi. MBBS is offered for a duration of five and a half years.
The aforementioned duration also includes one year of compulsory internship. During the internship period, students are given practical training to become successful health practitioners. The internship period also includes ward posting. After the successful completion of the MBBS programme, students could either pursue higher education such as MD, MS, etc. or start their practice. All India Institute of Medical Sciences Delhi offers internships at its attached hospital, i.e., AIIMS Hospital New Delhi.
AIIMS Delhi also offers BSc and MSc courses. After completing the BSc Nursing course from the institute, students can become Home Care Nurses, Junior Psychiatric Nurses, Nursing Executives, and others. The organisations which recruit BSc Nursing students include The Indian Red Cross Society, Fortis Healthcare, Columbia Asia Hospital, and others. BSc Nursing students are taught the core values involving Empathy, Human Dignity, Professionalism, Integrity, Autonomy, and others. These values are very important while taking care of the patients. Overall with a degree in Medical Sciences, students can become Academic Researchers, Clinical Research Associates, and others.

placements.overview: AIIMS Delhi has an active placement and training cell. The institute has not released their official placement data but according to the NIRF 2025 report which documented placements during 2024, the median package offered during PG 1-year and PG 3-year placements stood at INR 20 LPA and INR 17 LPA, respectively. While, for UG 3-year and UG 4-year it was INR 12.50 LPA and INR 16 LPA, respectively. Also, the median package for PG 3-year and PG 6-year students stood at INR 34 LPA. reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Nursing - Batch of 2018
reviews_list.review_title: I am totally satisfied with the memories of college.

review_content.Placements: Approximately 80 percent of students got placed. The package offered ranges from 6-12 LPA. Government exams like NORCET are conducted by AIIMS for us. Internship is offered for the last 6 months with a stipend of Rs. 14,250, which we can use to cover our expenses. The top role offered is superintendent.
review_content.Infrastructure: There are top-level facilities in the classroom with Wi-Fi, labs, and the library. There are ventilation and AC rooms. It has a top-level hostel facility with a good mess and canteen. There are medical facilities for students and teaching staff members. Sports and games are also available in the sports ground.

reviews_list.batch_info: MD in Physiology - Batch of 2024
reviews_list.review_title: My honest review about my college.

review_content.Placements: The placements are not guaranteed by the college as they make you perfect doctors and you have an option to either practice in a private clinic or else join some institute for presidentship. The interns could join the same institute once they clear the interview for the JRship, there's no such preference for the internal students. Being a medical college of course it provides an internship of 6 months giving you a chance to sit in each department. At present the interns are paid an amount of Rs. 18000 per month for their services.
review_content.Infrastructure: There are many courses available under MD and Ph.D. degrees. These courses are remarkable and comparable to any other colleges in the state. Exam in the college is conducted semester-wise. A final exam is conducted and the results are considered for eligibility for placement. The hostel facility is excellent here with single rooms being allowed for each student, high-speed free Wi-Fi service, a lift in the hostels, and a common TV room on each floor. Each room is provided with a bed with mattress, a chair and table, and a godrej almirah making it perfect.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Medical Technology (Radiography) - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Nice, spectacular, peaceful environment of college and totally satisfied.

review_content.Placements: There is no one left unemployed after pursuing the degree. The highest package offered in this course is 20 LPA, the average package is 12 LPA, and the lowest package is 8 LPA. Many medical companies like Vedanta and Medicare offer opportunities to us. You can serve as a radiographer, technical officer, senior technical officer, or chief technical officer.
review_content.Infrastructure: There is a well-maintained library, Wi-Fi, and classrooms provided by AIIMS for students. There are a total of 14 messes, coffee shops, juice corners, a quad, and a playground for playing cricket, badminton, table tennis, basketball, etc. There is a well-established gym and swimming pool for students. The most interesting thing is that all of these facilities are free of cost.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Medical Technology (Radiography) - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Bachelor of medical radiology and imaging technology from AIIMS NEW DELHI.

review_content.Placements: After getting a pass out from this prestigious institute you have many opportunities to explore and on placements also you will get a good priority in comparison. The package depends on where you are working in which hospital institute or medical college you are working in a government sector and whether you are a permanent employee your package will be around 8 to 10 lacs per annum. The post will be radiographer after promotions you will be upgraded to technical officer then senior technical officer then chief technical officer. The package will also be increased according to your post.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Nursing - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: I am absolutely satisfied. It has value for money.

review_content.Placements: There are a total of 100 seats available. To get a government job as a Nursing Officer, students need to clear both the Prelims and Main exams of NORCET. Almost 80% of students get a job every year. 4th year students get internships in the last 6 months, paying up to Rs. 13,000 per month, before completing the course.
review_content.Infrastructure: Our campus is very neat and clean, with a guard every 20 meters, making it very safe. Our classes run in a lecture theatre with AC on it. We have a library running 24/7, and we have different departmental labs like anatomy and microbiology. Our hostel is also very good for single rooms to double and triple rooms with Wi-Fi.

reviews_list.batch_info: M.Sc. in Biophysics - Batch of 2021
reviews_list.review_title: It is the best college in Delhi for medical studies.

review_content.Placements: It provided an adventurous experience as we had to manage numerous things at the same time like experience, learning, and trying to find leisure time in such a hectic program. I used to get a salary of Rs. 2,500 per month as a stipend. Overall, it is a very good place to practice medicine. Our college also has 3 primary health care centers (PHCs) which give a large scope for clinical practice. There is almost a 100% chance of getting a well-reputed job in a white coat with a good salary package and government facilities.
review_content.Infrastructure: The hostel facility is not superb but it is good. I would rate it 7 out of 10 with single rooms, tables, beds, and a book track. Staff are cleaning the hostel every now and then. It is not great, but structure-wise, it is well-maintained.

course_faqs.answer: Yes, AIIMS Delhi is almost free for all the programmes including MBBS MD MS PG Diploma M.Ch. Students must make a one-time payment between INR 5,000 to INR 6,000 which is the fee for the complete MBBS course of 5.5 years.

reviews.review_heading: I am totally satisfied with the memories of college.
reviews.review_text: There are top-level facilities in the classroom with Wi-Fi, labs, and the library. There are ventilation and AC rooms. It has a top-level hostel facility with a good mess and canteen. There are medical facilities for students and teaching staff members. Sports and games are also available in the sports ground.

reviews.review_heading: My honest review about my college.
reviews.review_text: There are many courses available under MD and Ph.D. degrees. These courses are remarkable and comparable to any other colleges in the state. Exam in the college is conducted semester-wise. A final exam is conducted and the results are considered for eligibility for placement. The hostel facility is excellent here with single rooms being allowed for each student, high-speed free Wi-Fi service, a lift in the hostels, and a common TV room on each floor. Each room is provided with a bed with mattres...

reviews.review_heading: Nice, spectacular, peaceful environment of college and totally satisfied.
reviews.review_text: There is a well-maintained library, Wi-Fi, and classrooms provided by AIIMS for students. There are a total of 14 messes, coffee shops, juice corners, a quad, and a playground for playing cricket, badminton, table tennis, basketball, etc. There is a well-established gym and swimming pool for students. The most interesting thing is that all of these facilities are free of cost.

reviews.review_heading: Bachelor of medical radiology and imaging technology from AIIMS NEW DELHI.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is best but hostel availability is very low for paramedical courses it will take around 2 years for allotment to a hostel as names come on the waiting list. reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied. It has value for money.
reviews.review_text: Our campus is very neat and clean, with a guard every 20 meters, making it very safe. Our classes run in a lecture theatre with AC on it. We have a library running 24/7, and we have different departmental labs like anatomy and microbiology. Our hostel is also very good for single rooms to double and triple rooms with Wi-Fi.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college in Delhi for medical studies.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facility is not superb but it is good. I would rate it 7 out of 10 with single rooms, tables, beds, and a book track. Staff are cleaning the hostel every now and then. It is not great, but structure-wise, it is well-maintained.

reviews.review_heading: My college provides clinical postings in all departments like surgery, OT, neuro, cardio, etc.
reviews.review_text: My college campus has good facilities like security, coffee shop, library, swimming pool, gym facility, cafeteria, badminton games, park facility for jogging & walking, In my classroom, facilities are projectors and comfortable seating arrangements. reviews.review_heading: Supportive nature of faculty members for students.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied loved my journey

reviews.review_heading: The college campus is known for its greenery.

reviews.review_heading: Campus is big. People can enjoy their campus life.

reviews.review_heading: Review of my dream college AIIMS, Delhi.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. Wi-Fi facility is provided in the hostel room and library. Classrooms are well-equipped with digital screens and air conditioning. Along with that, we are also provided with swimming pool, gym, library, reading rooms, and sports areas for table tennis, badminton, basketball, volleyball, etc. Mess and canteen food quality is fine. Medical facilities, including free treatment and medicine, is provided to all students.

reviews.review_heading: Nurses at AIIMS New Delhi.
reviews.review_text: AIIMS Delhi is one of the top medical colleges in India. The campus area is very large, accommodating many departments and hostels. In this course, you will be taught in well-equipped classrooms with projectors, speakers, AC, etc. There are labs for practical knowledge, and a library that is open 24/7. The hostels for nursing students are very spacious, accommodating around 300-400 students. The rooms are well-furnished and ventilated. The hostel has a mess which serves good quality food and is ...

reviews.review_heading: The insights of AIIMS New Delhi. Personal and professional development.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of AIIMS is very vast. Every department has its own 10-story building, like surgical block, mother-and-child block, RPC eye centre, trauma centre and many more. The classrooms are equipped with modernized projector. There are labs for hematology, anatomy, physiology, etc. The library is very big. It has all medical books, new editions and publications. It has Wi-Fi and a big sitting area with air conditioned. It is 24/7 open for everyone. The hostel's facilities are very good....

reviews.review_heading: The truth about AIIMS Delhi.
reviews.review_text: Hostel mess fee was ₹1300 per year. The electricity and gym fees were ₹300 for a year. There are several fests organized, but the most amazing fest is Pulse at AIIMS, New Delhi. The classrooms are big and ventilated along with research labs being available for thesis research.

overview_faqs.question: Does Saveetha Institute of Medical and Technical Sciences refund fees?
overview_faqs.answer: Several salient features of Saveetha Institute of Medical and Technical Sciences' return policy are: The majority of the institute's programs, including MBBS, BDS, B.Tech, and others, have clear return policies. After deducting administrative fees, funds are reimbursed to students who opt to withdraw their acceptance prior to the final day of admission. Usually, 1-2 weeks after classes begin, the deadline for admissions is reached. The following guidelines will apply to refunds in the event that a student departs after the final admissions date: Refundable 75% of fees if departure occurs within 30 days before the deadline (registration expenses excluded). Refundable 50% of fees if departure occurs within 30 to 90 days. If you depart after the final admittance date, you won't get a refund. A refund application must be completed.

paragraphs: SIMATS Chennai admission process 2025are decided on both merit and entrance basis. SIMATS accepts theNEET examfor admission tomedical science courses. All admissions granted by SIMATS Chennai are provisional in nature. The confirmation of admissions for SIMATS, Chennai is done by theAnna University/ Directorate of Technical Education, Chennai to which, the institute is affiliated.

Also known asSaveetha University,SIMATS, Chennai offers various courses at UG, PG, and PhD levels across the fields of Engineering, Architecture, Law, Nursing, Medical, and Management. The scores obtained in the NEET-UG, GATE, TANCET and TNEA entrance exams are used to decide the Saveetha Universityadmissions to theMBBS, BTech, MBA, and MTech courses respectively.

SIMATS Chennai delivers education through 16 schools specialised in different fields. Some of these are Dental College,Saveetha Engineering College, Medical College, and School of Law. paragraphs: The details for the 2023 drive are not released as of now. However, the NIRF report 2023 is out. According to the report, 108 MBA, 121 LLB/BA LLB/BBA LLB, 30 LLM, 1,080 BTech, 28 MTech, 69 BDS, 40 MDS and 56 MD students were placed during Saveetha University placements 2022. The median package offered to MBA, LLB/BA LLB/BBA LLB and LLM students stood at INR 6.45 LPA, INR 5.8 LPA and INR 6 LPA, respectively. For BTech and MTech courses, the median package offered was INR 3.8 LPA and INR 4.5 LPA. Further, for BDS, MDS and MD students, the median package offered during Saveetha University placements 2022 was INR 3.8 LPA, INR 6 LPA and INR 15.6 LPA, respectively.

paragraphs: Maulana Azad Institute of Dental Sciences admissionsare entrance-based. The institute accepts national-level entrance examsNEETandNEET MDSfor UG and PG admissions, respectively. MAIDS Delhi offers BDS and MDS at UG and PG levels in the Dental field in affiliation withDelhi University. Candidates are required to apply online on the official website of the Faculty of Medical Sciences, DU for BDS and MDS admission.

Admission to MAIDS Delhi courses is throughNEETandNEET MDSscores. Candidates are required to take admission through the Faculty of Medical Sciences, DU. Find belowMaulana Azad Institute of Dental Sciences coursesalong with their eligibility and selection criteria:

Maulana Azad Institute of Dental Sciences fees vary for UG and PG courses. The fee might include multiple components such as caution deposit, tuition fee, exam fee, registration, etc. Some of the components are one-time paid while others are paid annually or semester-wise. Find belowMAIDS Delhi feesfor BDS and MDS courses:
Note:This information is sourced from the official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change.

MAIDS Delhi seat intake is defined by the institute for UG and PG admission. Out of the total intake, seats are offered under All India Quota and DU Quota. Check below the Maulana Azad Institute of Dental Sciences seat intake and reservation criteria:
50% All India Quota
50% DU Quota
15% of UG total seats on All India Quota
85% of total UG seats are filled on a merit basis in NEET through Delhi University as State Quota

Maulana Azad Institute of Dental Sciences admission processincludes multiple steps. Candidates need to register for BDS or MDS course at Faculty of Medical Sciences, DU. Find below step-wise MAIDS Delhi admission process:
STEP 1: MAIDS Delhi Application Process 2025

Candidates after qualifying NEET or NEET MDS have to register for the respective counselling for both 50% DU Quota and 50% All India Quota. Once, students are allotted seat by MCC, they need to register on the official website of Faculty of Medical Sciences, DU. Below is the application fee for BDS and MDS programmes:
General/ OBC - INR 750
SC/ ST- INR 550
SC/ ST/ PwD-INR 2,000 per course
For all other categories: INR 1,000 per course
STEP 2: Merit List

Faculty of Medical Sciences, DU releases a merit list based on the rank secured by the aspirants. The institute acceptsNEET-UGscore for BDS andNEET MDSscore for MDS programme. The admission would be made strictly based on merit of the eligible candidates in each category, determined by marks obtained in the NEET or NEET MDS score.
STEP 3: Counselling and Seat Allotment

Selected candidates are further called for counselling. Candidates are required to select MAIDS BDS or MDS during counselling to get a seat in the institute. Aspirants who have been allotted a seat receive an admission letter. They need to pay a programme fee to confirm their seat in the institute.

The pathology lab is awesome but needs a lot of maintenance. The hostel facility is good, but the canteen and the mess are not good. There are many other infrastructure related issues.

reviews.review_heading: MS from the Maulana Azad institute of dental Science.

Their were proper labs for the students hands on practice. Canteen, Wi-Fi, library etc. Were also available for the students. Hostel facilities were also of good quality.

reviews.review_heading: Everything is perfect except few hostels.
reviews.review_text: Wifi is not available for students. However ,proper pre clinical prosthodontic, orthodontic  , haematology ,OP and other labs are there. There are separate lecture halls which are well conditioned and spacious. A separate library is there which stays open during college hours and also offers a variety of books along with research journals. There is a common hostel for both BDS and MBBS students. However,to be honest various forms of discrimination is being practiced against BDS students for prov...

reviews.review_heading: It is the best dental government college in Delhi.
reviews.review_text: Our college has a well-managed library. The infrastructure in our college is kind of average as it is one the oldest and reputed institutions in the country. Everything available here is good, including mess, sports, medical support, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Placement chances, good infrastructures.
reviews.review_text: The college has a large classroom. About 250 students can situate them. The library is good and contains all medical books. Not just medical book also contains journal books. We have our own sports ground outside MAMC, there we play any outdoor game like football, basketball, etc.

reviews.review_heading: It is the number one college in India for the available courses.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure facilities were better. The college was situated in Delhi. We had better Wi-Fi connections with a good level AT laboratory. There were better instruments and buildings in the college. The campus was huge and beautiful with a garden. Many play stations and playgrounds like basketball, cricket, tennis, and football were available.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS) - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: It's truly a paradise for every student living the university life in Pune.

content.Placements: All the students of my batch are either working in clinics or pursuing postgraduation courses. My seniors have also gone abroad. Others are preparing for entrance exams. Some people have changed their course. The college exposes us to academics as well as other activities like debates, drama, sports etc.
content.Infrastructure: Free Wi-Fi is available. The library is huge and has all the study materials. A sports week, talent week, cultural and an annual function are conducted in the college. Apart from these, the college conducts an annual meet for all DY Patil colleges, called DPU night. We have amazing hostel rooms with a kitchen, and each room having an attached bathroom. Food available is a bit expensive, but it is worth it. We have an all-night cafeteria for students. The amenities are amazing.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS) - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: The college is good in terms of faculty members, placements, and infrastructure.

content.Placements: Every year, around 70 to 75% of the students get an internship from the campus. The special attention is given to the students in an internship, and the students are well-guided by experienced doctors in their respective fields. Postings are done to village areas and needy people for free of cost. Discipline is well-maintained on the campus.
content.Infrastructure: The classrooms, library, medical facilities, sports infrastructure, etc., are good on the campus. The whole campus is enabled with the Wi-Fi. The campus has an anti-ragging. The hostel rooms are good. The quality of food in the canteen is good. The security system is excellent. A gym is present for boys as well as girls along with the trainers.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS) - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: This is one of the best colleges that can secure your future.

review_content.Placements: The campus is big, and there is lots of stuff to do. The college has modern equipment for treatment, and it’s purely charitable. The class size is 100. The fee per year is 5.5 lakhs, and 80 out of 100 students get placed in good government hospitals, as its degree is of great importance. It’s ranked 6th in India among deemed colleges. There are many scholarships and research opportunities available, and the internship has a stipend too. Almost every student gets an internship after the course.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college has the best infrastructure, with Wi-Fi available 24/7, even in the hostel. There is a good, huge library that is well organized and divided systematically between UG and PG. The classrooms are airy and spacious, as well as air-conditioned, with good computer systems for advanced learning. The hospital is huge and systematic, with proper hygiene and sterilization, as well as a good patient inflow. The hostel is very comfortable with proper necessities, and the quality of food is good too, with a variety in the menu to prevent boredom. There are grounds and a big sports stadium for indoor games and outdoor games like cricket and football.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS) - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Good infrastructure, faculty, average hostel food, and hostel rooms.

review_content.Placements: I joined this college last year through the NEET special round. This college has a beautiful campus. The teachers and lecturers are well-trained professionals and doctors. The course is offered at 5.3 lacs for students under the management quota, and it varies for students joining here based on NEET rankings.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college has a wonderful infrastructure with a vast library, labs with all the required instruments, and smart classrooms with AC that can comfortably accommodate around 100 students. Each batch has around 100 students; these batches are further divided into 4 so that all students can be paid attention to by the faculty. All the labs are well maintained, with all the instruments required for each student, and lab faculty are present to help students with all the experiments along with the subject lecturers. The hostel is a well-maintained residential place for students, costing $90000 for non-AC rooms, including mess feels, and $140000 for AC rooms. All the rooms are two, sharing separate beds, tables, and cupboards. The college conducts many sports and events for students. They have a vast outdoor ground near the hostel for cricket and football, along with an indoor stadium for volleyball, throwball, badminton, table tennis, tennis, and many more. All the students have free consultation and treatment for any medical emergency; they only need to pay for the extra materials used, and pharmacy bills for the medicine are also provided at a low cost in the hospital. The mess provides us with breakfast along with coffee, tea, and milk from 7:00-9:00 in the morning, lunch from 12:30-2:00, and dinner from 7:30-10:00 with evening snacks and hot beverages, the same as for breakfast from 4:30-6:00.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: This is one of the best colleges that can secure your future.

content.Placements: The campus is big, and there is lots of stuff to do. The college has modern equipment for treatment, and it’s purely charitable. The class size is 100. The fee per year is 5.5 lakhs, and 80 out of 100 students get placed in good government hospitals, as its degree is of great importance. It’s ranked 6th in India among deemed colleges. There are many scholarships and research opportunities available, and the internship has a stipend too. Almost every student gets an internship after the course.
content.Infrastructure: The college has the best infrastructure, with Wi-Fi available 24/7, even in the hostel. There is a good, huge library that is well organized and divided systematically between UG and PG. The classrooms are airy and spacious, as well as air-conditioned, with good computer systems for advanced learning. The hospital is huge and systematic, with proper hygiene and sterilization, as well as a good patient inflow. The hostel is very comfortable with proper necessities, and the quality of food is good too, with a variety in the menu to prevent boredom. There are grounds and a big sports stadium for indoor games and outdoor games like cricket and football.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure, faculty, average hostel food, and hostel rooms.

content.Placements: I joined this college last year through the NEET special round. This college has a beautiful campus. The teachers and lecturers are well-trained professionals and doctors. The course is offered at 5.3 lacs for students under the management quota, and it varies for students joining here based on NEET rankings.
content.Infrastructure: The college has a wonderful infrastructure with a vast library, labs with all the required instruments, and smart classrooms with AC that can comfortably accommodate around 100 students. Each batch has around 100 students; these batches are further divided into 4 so that all students can be paid attention to by the faculty. All the labs are well maintained, with all the instruments required for each student, and lab faculty are present to help students with all the experiments along with the subject lecturers. The hostel is a well-maintained residential place for students, costing $90000 for non-AC rooms, including mess feels, and $140000 for AC rooms. All the rooms are two, sharing separate beds, tables, and cupboards. The college conducts many sports and events for students. They have a vast outdoor ground near the hostel for cricket and football, along with an indoor stadium for volleyball, throwball, badminton, table tennis, tennis, and many more. All the students have free consultation and treatment for any medical emergency; they only need to pay for the extra materials used, and pharmacy bills for the medicine are also provided at a low cost in the hospital. The mess provides us with breakfast along with coffee, tea, and milk from 7:00-9:00 in the morning, lunch from 12:30-2:00, and dinner from 7:30-10:00 with evening snacks and hot beverages, the same as for breakfast from 4:30-6:00.

content.Placements: MBBS courses in government medical colleges in India, including MLNMC Prayagraj, do not offer traditional campus placements like engineering or management institutes. Medical graduates are required to undergo a Compulsory Rotatory Residential Internship for one year. Some graduates directly apply as general physicians in private hospital, PHCs, Tutors, and some open their own clinics.

paragraphs: King George's Medical University admissions 2026 are based on certain entrance exams for most of the courses. Candidates willing to apply for admission in the university must fill outthe application form online. Find below the step-wise explanation of theKGMU admission process:-
STEP 1: King George's Medical University Application Process

Candidates must go to the official website of the separate entrance tests that are being accepted for their selected courses in order to apply for KGMU admissions for a variety of UG and PG courses. faqs.question: What is the total tuition fee for BSc at KGMU?
faqs.answer: The total fees for BSc courses at KGMU range from INR 48,000 to INR 3 lakh . Fees for the BSc programme also varies according to reservation quota. Candidates from general category are required to pay INR 48,100 (With Hostel) and 43,200 (Without Hostel). However, OBC/ SC/ ST category students are required to pay INR 42100 (With Hostel) and INR 37200 (Without Hostel). Usually, the tuition fee is paid at the beginning of each academic year.

faqs.question: What is the NEET SS application fee?
faqs.answer: The NEET SS application fee is INR 3,500. The fee is same for candidates belonging to each category. This is the application fee for each group. Hence, candidates planning to apply for two groups will have to pay INR 7,000 (3,500 + 3,500). The fee has to be paid in online mode, via credit/debit card or net banking. NBE states, "Applications forms once submitted cannot be withdrawn. Fee shall neither be carried forward to a future date nor refunded under any circumstances. Application once submitted cannot be withdrawn. Any claim for refund, adjustment or carrying forward of Application fee will not be entertained. Examination fees in respect of candidates who are absent or have been declared ineligible due to any reason will be forfeited." As compared to last year, the fee has been reduced. Last year, the fee amount was INR 4,250 for each group.

SRM Dental College, Ramapuram admission process contains various steps. To be eligible for admission, candidates are to follow all the steps. The admission process starts with applying for their desired courses by visiting NEET UG's and NEET MDS's official websites. Additionally, candidates are required to visit the college's official website to apply for admission. The steps below contain SRM Dental College, Ramapuram admission process 2025:
Step 1: Application Process 2025

To be eligible for admission to any courses at SRM Dental College, Ramapuram, candidates are required to fulfil the eligibility requirements before applying for admission. overview_faqs.question: Is SOA University a good university?
overview_faqs.answer: SOA is one of the top private universities in Bhubaneswar, India. It is allotted a band rank of 1201-1400 by the QS World University Rankings 2025. The NIRF 2022 ranked SOA University in 16th position. SOA University has been continuously ranked among the top 20 Universities in India by NIRF. SOA is approved by the UGC and accredited by NAAC, ABET, and NBA. It is also recognised by the Scientific and Industrial Research Organisation (SIRO). The SOA University's placement drive for the batch graduating in 2022 has been successfully completed. According to the most recent data, INR 42 LPA was the highest salary package provided during the 2022 placement drive. Students from SOA University's numerous programmes, including B.Tech, MBA, MCA and BDS among others, received favourable offers from reputable businesses during the placement drive for 2022.

overview_faqs.question: What is the hostel fee structure of SOA University?
overview_faqs.answer: The hostel fee structure for SOA University depends upon the number of accommodations, for double sharing with Air conditioning the fee is INR 1.20 Lacs per annum. For triple-sharing rooms with Air conditioning, the fee is INR 90,000 per annum. Siksha O Anusandhan University provides separate hostels for boys and girls with 24-hour security and Wi-Fi facilities. There are 13 boys and 11 girls hostel. The hostels also have mess facilities providing hygienic and nutritious food. The mess charges are not included in the hostel fee, candidates need to pay INR 36,000 per annum to avail of the campus mess.

review_summary.college_name: SOA University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Good college, okay placement.

content.Placements: There are many students in our batch. In our institute, the highest package was about 12 LPA. Our top recruiting companies are Dell, Wipro, TCS, etc. In our institution, many of the students were hired by TCS and WIPRO. All types of roles are available.
content.Infrastructure: In our institute, we have smart classrooms with a good internet connection. Our labs and library are very good, and the classrooms are well air-conditioned. Our hostel food is very nice, and we have good sanitation in our hostel. Wi-Fi is available but not too fast.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Good, but if you do not take the risk of money, then come to study here. Otherwise, very good.

content.Placements: In this college, the placement rate is above 85%. The top companies are TCS, Wipro, Infosys, Accenture, Cognizant, Dell, And Flipkart (which comes once this year), etc. The average package is 6 to 7 LPA. Recently, Accenture conducted mass recruitment, taking 300 candidates from ITER and providing packages of 12 LPA to around 77 students of the final year. Generally, companies come for placements around the 5th semester and continue to the last semester. Good, but not like KIIT, Odisha.
content.Infrastructure: In the case of the hostel, the fees are 1,10,000 for 1 year, and according to it, the food is good in quality and quantity. The hostel infrastructure is also good and study-friendly. The faculty are good. For machine learning, high-quality labs are provided. In the library, the behavior of teachers is good and very friendly. Free medicine and minor treatment are provided by SUM IMS, SOA. No functions are organized by the college except for the annual function, but many smaller events are organized, like robotics camps, the SOA Cup, and many more. It deserves a 5-star rating.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: I chose the best inter for real.

content.Placements: If you study, then you will one hundred percent get a job in our college. 90 percent of students are placed. The average package is 5 LPA. Meanwhile, the highest package is 42 LPA according to current data from Amazon, Infosys, etc top companies visit here.
content.Infrastructure: The environment is so friendly. There are clean and neat classrooms. There is AC in every single class. The professors are friendly and understanding. The hostel is good, but the mess food is not that great. If you get into the habit, you will learn to adjust. The environment is so friendly.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: One of the best things about the university is that ragging is strictly prohibited on campus.

content.Placements: 85 to 90 percent students are placed in my course. Out of these students, 35 to 40 percent students are in a specialisation course. The highest Package offered is 46 LPA, the average package 6 to 6.5 LPA, the lowest Package offered is 3.3 to 3.5 LPA. High paying recruiters are Microsoft, Amazon, Adobe, Deloitte, PwC, Informatica, ServiceNow, Zscaler, Yugabyte. Mass Recruiters are TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Cognizant GenC/Next, Capgemini, Accenture, and DXC Technology. 60 to 70 percent of students secure internships. Top Roles offered are Software Development Engineer SDE, System Engineer or Analyst, Full Stack Developer, Cloud Support Engineer, Data Analyst or Consultant, and Quality Assurance QA Engineer.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Dissatisfied because of job opportunities.

content.Placements: My college placements are average. Many companies come to our college, but pick very few students every year. Though the college claims 100% placements, that's not the case. Many of my seniors are struggling to get jobs. Academics are good but lack in extracurricular activities.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is great, but the non-AC hostels are not that good. If you want to stay in good condition, I recommend staying out of the college in a flat or PG. PGs are great there and very cheap. You can find lots of them. The library, Wi-Fi, and canteens are great, and there is no problem there.

reviews.review_heading: Good college, okay placement.
reviews.review_text: In our institute, we have smart classrooms with a good internet connection. Our labs and library are very good, and the classrooms are well air-conditioned. Our hostel food is very nice, and we have good sanitation in our hostel. Wi-Fi is available but not too fast.

reviews.review_heading: Good, but if you do not take the risk of money, then come to study here. Otherwise, very good.
reviews.review_text: In the case of the hostel, the fees are 1,10,000 for 1 year, and according to it, the food is good in quality and quantity. The hostel infrastructure is also good and study-friendly. The faculty are good. For machine learning, high-quality labs are provided. In the library, the behavior of teachers is good and very friendly. Free medicine and minor treatment are provided by SUM IMS, SOA. No functions are organized by the college except for the annual function, but many smaller events are organiz...

reviews.review_heading: I chose the best inter for real.
reviews.review_text: The environment is so friendly. There are clean and neat classrooms. There is AC in every single class. The professors are friendly and understanding. The hostel is good, but the mess food is not that great. If you get into the habit, you will learn to adjust. The environment is so friendly.

reviews.review_heading: One of the best things about the university is that ragging is strictly prohibited on campus.
reviews.review_text: The biggest relief here is that almost all our classrooms are air-conditioned. For CSE, the labs are pretty solid, and we have dedicated labs. Most PCs have decent i5/i7 processors and run the necessary software without lagging. You get plenty of lab time, but strict attendance is maintained. There are multiple hostels for boys and girls. They are separate. You can choose between AC and Non AC rooms. The rooms are generally clean and tidy. Bathrooms are cleaned daily.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied because of job opportunities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is great, but the non-AC hostels are not that good. If you want to stay in good condition, I recommend staying out of the college in a flat or PG. PGs are great there and very cheap. You can find lots of them. The library, Wi-Fi, and canteens are great, and there is no problem there.

reviews.review_heading: Definitely a good university in Odisha.
reviews.review_text: You will definitely like the infrastructure, and the food is 8.5/10, depending on your personal Taste. You should definitely try the Biriyani, which you will definitely like. Mostly, you will get a variety of food, and most of the time, the food is edible and properly cooked.

reviews.review_heading: Review of the Institute of Technical Education and Research.
reviews.review_text: There are very bad facilities, as they do not have any proper behavior. The food here is like they would give you food prepared under less hygienic conditions and leftover vegetables. The timing of the hostel is the worst. They treat our hostel like a ladies' hostel because our return timing is 7:00 PM.

reviews.review_heading: The campus is well organized. Professors are well qualified, and placement in the college is solid.

The drainage system is fine inside the campus. The hostels are perfect as well (from a male perspective). The food is good. If you don't like the food, you can complain about it. At the end of the day, you will like the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: SOA is a mix of pros and cons.
reviews.review_text: The college has good infrastructure and good technical labs. Wi-Fi facility is available 24x7. All classrooms are smart. It also has a good central library where students can study. The hostel is not upto mark. Mess food is average. The hostel culture is also not that good.

reviews.review_heading: Review of SOA University - Siksha 'O' Anusandhan.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are good for safety issues. There is a good environment, but we have to face internet issues. Otherwise, everything is good, like cleaning. The food is average. Hostels are best for study and security. There is no ragging. It is under CCTV surveillance and always under monitoring conditions.

reviews.review_heading: College is good. They should conduct more events.
reviews.review_text: In our college, all the facilities are okay. The Wi-Fi speed is very slow and laggy. Classrooms and library are top notch not IIT level. Facilities quality is good. The quality of food is sometimes good sometimes not. Sports are also good over here and chances are given.

reviews.review_heading: Inter and Teach sounds weird.
reviews.review_text: I mean the Wi-Fi all over college, food , even the cafeteria and all are not pocket friendly. The medical facilities are nice and fine. Inter is well known for sports. Out of all 5 campuses, it has been maintaining the streak of being the SOA cup winners. We had a sports fest from Dec 4 - Jan 7th 2026. Even you have Inter College leagues, etc.

reviews.review_heading: An absolutely mediocre college with basic facilities but decent food and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is decent. Wi-Fi is available in the hostel premises, but not in the library, which is disappointing. Labs and classrooms are decent. The library can be upgraded, but its alright. The quality of food is decent, better than what many other colleges offer. The hostel provides basic facilities. The campus does have a sports culture, but the area designed for sports related activities is quite small. Medical facilities are available. The college also hosts sports tournaments. I wi...

reviews.review_heading: Review of what a good experience was in my college life.
reviews.review_text: In our college, there were so many different types of courses available. Different courses had different blocks. Fully Wi-Fi available inside the college campus. Classrooms were smart rooms, and a big central library was also available on campus. In the hostel, they provided Wi-Fi, a gym, four times a day food, power backup, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Review of my college opinion and my experience.
reviews.review_text: The college campus is so big and has full Wi-Fi. Classrooms are fully AC with smart rooms. One central library is also inside the campus. Inside the hostel, full Wi-Fi is available. Both indoor and outdoor sports facilities are available on the campus.

PGIDS Rohtak popular programmes are BDS and MDS. PGIMS Rohtak BDS and MDS students are taught the treatment of diseases and dental defects, specifically the restoration of the function, form, and esthetics of those hard tissues affected by trauma, developmental disorders, dental caries, and regressive alterations of the teeth. At the UG level, the college offers BDS programme to students with a seat intake of 100 students per year. At the PG level, the college offers MDS in 9 specialties, namely Conservative Dentistry, Prosthodontics, Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery, Periodontics, Pedodontics, Orthodontics, Public health Dentistry, Oral Pathology and Oral Medicine and Radiology. In addition to these courses, the college also provides Dental Hygienist, Dental Mechanic programmes, and PG Certificate courses. faqs.question: Is studying at Post-Graduate Institute of Dental Science expensive?

faqs.answer: A:    PGIDS, Rohtak is ranked in the top 3 dental colleges in India. It is controlled entirely by government. This Institute is running BDS with 100 admissions per year and MDS in 9 specialties.No, you cannot join PGIDS, Rohtak without NEET for BDS. As the institute is entirely government and there is no direct admission or donation type admission so, you have to clear NEET-UG and clear the required cutoff to apply for counselling process.
faqs.question: Can I join Post-Graduate Institute of Dental Science without NEET for BDS?

faqs.answer: A:    If you want to take admission in PGIDS, Rohtak then you will also be aware that it is in the top 3 rank of dental colleges in India.To get admission in BDS at PGIDS, Rohtak, students must pass Class 12 from a recognised board with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks in PCB/Biotech combined (40% for SC/ST). Candidates seeking admission also needs an NEET dental scorecard for both UG and PG courses. After qualifying for the NEET entrance exam, candidates must participate in the Haryana NEET Counselling, conducted by the Directorate of Medical Education and Research (DMER) in Haryana. You will also need to clear the cutoff marks to get eligible for admission.
faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for the BDS at Post-Graduate Institute of Dental Science?

faqs.answer: A:    To be eligible for admission to BDS courses at PGIDS, Rohtak, candidates are required to pay NEET UG application fee for admission.The application fee can be paid in an online mode via Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking or UPI.  The category-wise application fees are given in the below table:CategoryApplication Fee (in INR)General1,700General EWS and OBC1,600SC, ST, PwD1,000Outside India9,500

review_content.Placements: The internship is provided by the college for 1 year for all students after the final year. The stipend offered is Rs. 24,000 per month. review_content.Infrastructure: There are lecture theatres in the dental college itself. Projectors are there in the lecture theatre. It has centralised AC. There are labs for every subject. faqs.question: Can students join Post-Graduate Institute of Dental Science directly without any entrance exam?
faqs.answer: No, you cannot pursue a Bachelor in Dental Surgery (BDS) in India without taking the NEET. In India, the sole entrance exam required for admission to undergraduate and post-graduate in medicine and dentistry, including BDS, is NEET. To gain admission to reputable dental colleges in India, BDS candidates must obtain a good score on the NEET exam and be eligible for admission.For admission to dentistry and medical programs in India, the National Testing Agency (NTA) administers NEET on behalf of the Medical Council of India (MCI) and the Dentistry Council of India (DCI). it is a highly competitive examination and the candidates are admitted based on how well they perform on the NEET exam and whether they meet the eligibility requirements. Thus, to pursue BDS in India, one must pass the NEET exam.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good coaching and clean college.

content.Placements: Around 80%-90% of students from our course were placed through campus recruitment drives. Highest package is 20 LPA. Lowest package is 5 LPA. Around 70%-75% of students secure an internship through campus drives. Top roles offered are software development engineer.
content.Infrastructure: Hostel has clean and well-maintained rooms, a common study hall, and a 24/7 water and electricity supply. Mess provides balanced diet food with vegetarian and non-vegetarian options. Facilities for both indoor and outdoor sports. Medical, 24/7 ambulance service.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Excellent infrastructure with supportive faculty and good placements.

content.Placements: I am part of the 2024 to 2028 batch. My seniors who passed away from this college received many packages mentioned below. Placement Percentage around 80 to 90% of students are placed from our course. The highest package is 20 LPA, the lowest package is 6 LPA, and the average package is 8 LPA. Some of the top recruiters included TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Cognizant, Accenture, HCL, and a few product based companies. Internship Opportunities Nearly 70 to 80% of students got internships, often in companies like TCS, Infosys, Startups, and local IT firms, which provided good exposure. The major roles offered are Software Developer, Analyst, Associate Engineer, System Engineer, Data Analyst, and Support Engineer.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Computer Science (Artificial Intelligence and Data Analytics) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Information about Sri Ramachandra life.

content.Placements: Our college offers 100% placements to eligible students. The average package offered is between 4 LPA and 10 LPA. The college has a dedicated placement team. The college organizes on-campus events to help students find jobs and internships. The college has a strong placement network.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has one of the largest medical libraries in the region, and collaborates with Harvard Medical International. It has a large collection of textbooks, journals, and more. We also have modern laboratories. It also exercises physiology labs with metabolic analyzers, treadmills, and more. There is a sports biomechanics lab with 3D cameras, forceplates, and more. We have a podiatry lab with foot pressure analysis systems. There is an anthropometry lab with stadiometers and more.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Medical Microbiology and Applied Molecular Biology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Sriher a glimpse. Absolutely good infrastructure and social life. The faculty is very friendly.

content.Placements: Our course doesn't have placement arrangements. So I have no idea about it. I don't know what I should say about this topic. But our college does provide a 6-month internship programme within the campus to have hands-on experience with everything we have learnt in these years.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available are top-notch. There are no compensations for infrastructure. All classrooms are equipped with Wi-Fi connections, smart boards, projectors, etc. The library has a vast number of books about various fields of study and journals. The canteen facilities and medical facilities are good because they have their hospital set up as this is a medical college.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure and faculty members.

content.Placements: There are 250 students in one batch. For MBBS internships are only required in the final year after completion of the course. According to central lawns internships are in the same hospital as the study. After MBBS and internship, there are multiple opportunities to go abroad for further training, as well as opportunities to remain in India and pursue an MS or an MD. As for research, the faculty members are incredibly helpful and the university offers grants for students who wish to engage in research. The medical college is also recognised by the USA for further studies there.

faqs.question: What is the fee structure for BSc programmes at SRIHER Chennai?

reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available are top-notch. There are no compensations for infrastructure. All classrooms are equipped with Wi-Fi connections, smart boards, projectors, etc. The library has a vast number of books about various fields of study and journals. The canteen facilities and medical facilities are good because they have their hospital set up as this is a medical college.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: We have four large lecture halls that accommodate all 250 students. The dissection hall for first-year students is Wi-Fi equipped with broadcasting. Teaching hospital has classrooms on every floor and within the wards for teaching. Hostel facilities for MBBS students are single rooms, with an option of attached washrooms or common washrooms. Wi-Fi is available on the campus. There are badminton, tennis, basketball, volleyball and throwball courts available. There is a swimming pool and gym for a...

reviews.review_heading: It is a high-rated college, and I suggest students enroll in it.
reviews.review_text: The maximum salary accredited to the students placed in recruitment is 14.8 LPA, and it was the highest one till now in the field of clinical nutrition. Ixcela and Nualtra are frequent recruiters who participate in the recruitment process throughout the academic year. A maximum number of students keep on enrolling in various courses at Sri Ramachandra Institute of Higher Education and Research. However, only a limited number of seats are open for all the disciplines. Seats are allotted based on ...

reviews.review_heading: I am from the M.Sc. in Clinical Nutrition course.
reviews.review_text: The employability rate was successfully higher throughout the end of the year. Top reputed clinics and some other corporates took part in the placement process of our institution. Some students become entrepreneurs and they start their own ventures.

reviews.review_heading: Dental course in Chennai.
reviews.review_text: The required dental equipment and other apparatus are bought once a year. Necessary radiology setups are settled in laboratories. Fire safety equipment, surveillance security, cameras, and necessary medical facilities are arranged in our college.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure, but I'm not satisfied with the faculty and people.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is good. It is completely air-conditioned. Wi-Fi is not allowed for students. There are all kinds of sports equipment and courts. There is a swimming pool and a gymnasium. There are multiple canteens where students can select food to buy. The mess serves South Indian cuisine. The college has a hospital as well.

reviews.review_heading: Safety for women, refreshment, cultural events, visits to the hospital.
reviews.review_text: So in college, we celebrate each and every festival that is celebrated across India, like Onam, Diwali, Dussehra. Mainly, our college is for fests and culturals. So, there is a visit of celebrities during this. Our college is offering a swimming club, sports club, tennis club, basketball club, cricket club, dance club, and singing club. Our college is having a wide variety of books that help in our study purpose with a central AC in the library.

reviews.review_heading: Strong faculty and practical learning for B.Sc Applied Psychology.
reviews.review_text:
Academic Facilities include well-equipped classrooms and psychology labs and access to a central library with online resources and journals. Hostel facilities include separate hostels for boys and girls with over 3,600 rooms. There is a continuous water and power supply with a resort-like ambiance. Food facilities include clean mess facilities offering nutritious food and multiple cuisines. On-campus canteens are also available. 
Sports & Recreation facilities are present in form of dedicated sp...

reviews.review_heading: I liked the sports and cultural department in our course.
reviews.review_text:
Our college will have many festivals like culturals, sports culturals, departmental culturals, etc. Our classrooms will have an air conditioners.
Our department has a library that contains every book we need and has a general Oxford library. Every week there will be an event happening; anyone can take part in any event.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the management and faculty of the college.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available at this college was really good. College management tries it's best to provide all the facilities such as labs, library, canteen, hostel etc. Multiple sports facilities were available for the students in the college campus. Hostel rooms were furnished and food in the mess was good to eat.

reviews.review_heading: Review of M.Sc. in Clinical Nutrition from the Sri Ramachandra Institute of higher education.
reviews.review_text: Yes, our college has good-quality facilities and infrastructure for the students of this course. Labs and libraries were available for the students better learning. Wi-Fi, canteen, hostel, sports, and other facilities were also given to the students. College canteen and hostel mess food was also good to eat.

reviews.review_heading: Top-notch facilities, but it is crowded.
reviews.review_text: Facilities-wise, it's okay, not that good. RAMACHANDRA is a brand. Classrooms are there to accommodate. The library was good. Canteen facilities are also good; there is a 24-hour working canteen there [ILLAI CAFE (24/7)]. The medical facilities were very nice and provided excellent care.

reviews.review_heading:
One of the finest college 
.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facility is good. The rooms are in good condition, and basic items like a fan, chair, table, cupboard, and all are provided by the hostel management. All the things are well maintained, including timely cleaning and washrooms. We also have good mess food. There is variety in the mess food, with separate sessions for South and North Indian cuisine. Meal quality is also good.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Sri Ramachandra Institute of Higher Education and Research Centre.
reviews.review_text: The college has very good infrastructure with good Wi-Fi facilities and labs with the greatest technology fully centralized. Classrooms have AC and good library facilities, which provide all medical books and the latest publications. Good-quality hostel food is provided in the mess.

reviews.review_heading: The Best Medical University in Chennai.
reviews.review_text: The facilities provided by us in our college include all the basic requirements like Wi-Fi access,  24*7 medical assistance, and both mess and hostel facilities with different types of beds. The food in the shared mess is average and some days there is a special menu.

admission_process.title: BHU Admission Process 2026

paragraphs: BHU admissionsare primarily entrance-based. All Indian applicants are required to take the CUET-UG exam conducted by the NTA. Candidates must apply online on the NTA CUET official website to register themselves. For PG courses, aspirants with a valid CUET-PG score can apply. Admission to some courses can be merit-based. BHU considers CUET-UG scores and normalised scores to create merit lists for each course.
What is the BHU Application Process 2026?

For UG courses admission through CUET, candidates have to complete theCUET-UG application process. Likewise, forBHU PG admissions, theCUET-PG applicationprocess has to be completed. For other courses, the aspirants can apply through BHU official website.

BHU counselling process for PG courses through CUET-PG is carried out in online mode. Registrations for it get started before CUET results are out and open after that for scorecard upload. Find below the detailed procedure of BHU CUET-PG counselling:
1 -Register on theBHU admission portal

Visit the university's official website(bhuonline.in)to participate in the online counselling process. To register, enter yourNTA application number, and other details along with your email ID and a passwordto activate the registration account.

Login with the Email ID and password entered during registration. After login, fill out the application and upload documents. Candidates must upload the documents inPDF/JPEG format. Moreover, the required documents are enlisted below:
Matriculation or its equivalent certificate
Class 12 mark sheet
Bachelor's mark sheet (make a single file of marks sheet of all semesters and then upload the same as a single document)
Caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS) and income certificate (SC/ST)
PwD certificate (if applicable)
BHU employee certificate (if applicable)
Certificate if admission under sports quota
Scanned copy of a recent colour photograph & signature
3 -Pay the BHU Counselling Registration Fee

In order to register successfully, anon-refundablefee has to be paid via debit card/credit card/net banking. Candidates canedit the application before fee payment. Find below the registration fee for each of the categories:
4 -Preference Entry Page

The preference entry page opens after the registration fee payment. Candidates can fill in their preferences separately for all the programmes in this form. Moreover, the result for the first seat allotment is declared within 8 to 10 days (approximately) after the publication of theCUET-PG result. Further, subsequent rounds for regular/paid fee seats for the BHU and affiliated colleges are carried out.

BHU feesinclude various components such as tuition fees, hostel fees, security deposit, library fees, etc. The fee payment shall be accepted annually or semester-wise. BHU fee structure varies depending upon the chosen course. It also varies for regular and paid seats. Candidates wanting to apply for afee refund from BHUhave to fill out a form. The university provides seat reservations toSC/ST/OBC/Physically Challenged. Moreover, the university has also paid seats (a maximum of 15% of the total seats). faqs.question: Does BHU accept admission through CUET?
faqs.answer: Yes, Banaras Hindu University accept CUET score for multiple UG courses, including BA (Hons), BCom (Hons) BSc (Hons), etc. The university is also offering admission to its PG courses based on merit in CUET-PG. Aspirants who meet the eligibility requirements can register on the BHU admission portal for counselling. faqs.question: What is the admission process for the BHU UET?
faqs.answer: BHU accepts CUET-UG scores for admission to several UG courses. Candidates seeking admission to BHU must apply online to register themselves. Follow the step-wise admission process as given below:The BHU application process is conducted in online mode through the official website of NTA (nta.ac.in). The fee for General category students is INR 750, INR 700 for OBC-NCL/EWS, and INR 650 for SC/ST/PwD/Transgender.Candidates need to download the admit card by visiting the official website of CUET 2025 and clicking on 'Download CUET Admit Card'.After the declaration of the CUET result, students seeking admission to BHU UG courses are required to apply online for CUET-UG Counselling on the BHU UG admission portal.Further, candidates are required to participate in an online counselling process for provisional admission to the course (s). After that, the final seat allotment will be done by BHU.

faqs.question: What is the last date for BHU admission?
faqs.answer: BHU accepts CUET scores for admission to UG and PG courses. The admissions are over within few weeks of CUET counselling. CUET-PG is usually jeld in March whereas, CUET-UG takes place in May. Students must check the complete schedule for exact dates. CUET applications for the coming year will begin in February and continue till April.

faqs.question: Can a one-year dropper student get admission into BHU?
faqs.answer: Banaras Hindu University course admissions is entrance-based for most of the programmes. Thus, one-year dropper student can apply for the desired course, however, qualifying the respective entrance is the a must. Apart from this, aspirant should meet the course-specific minimum eligibility requirements as well.Moreover, the student can be asked to submit an application regarding the reason for drop out. Sometimes even this is not required.

nirf.description:
BHU has received strong ranks by the NIRF under the 'Overall' category. Provided parameters including, Teaching, Graduation Outcome, Inclusivity and Research, the institute is ranked in a good position as compared to other institutes by the NIRF 2025. In the 'Overall' category, the institute's ranks have shown a fluctuation when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2025, BHU climbed 1 rank to #10 rank in the 'Overall' category by the NIRF ranking.
One can observe that within the category of 'University', the institute's ranking has fluctuation when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2025, BHU fell 1 rank to #6 rank in the 'University' category by the NIRF ranking.
It is to be noticed that the institute has shown a fluctuating trend in the 'Management' category as compared to the ranking of preceding years. In 2025, BHU fell 12 ranks to #60 rank in the 'Management' category by the NIRF ranking.
It is noticeable that in the 'Medical' category, the institute's ranks have shown an increasing trend when evaluated against the ranking of the prior year. In 2025, BHU climbed 1 rank to #6 rank in the 'Medical' category by the NIRF ranking.

qs_world.description:
As per the overall score, BHU has been placed at a good position by the QS World University Rankings under the 'Top Global Universities' category, reflecting its exceptional performance in areas like Teaching, Research, Graduation Outcomes, and creating an inclusive, quality learning environment. When compared to the ranking from the previous years, it has been seen that in the 'Top Global Universities' category, the institute's ranks have shown stability in trend. In 2026, BHU's rank is #1001, the same as last year's rank in the 'Top Global Universities' category by the QS World University Rankings.
One can observe that within the category of 'Asia', the institute's ranking has fallen when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2026, BHU fell 21 ranks to #224 rank in the 'Asia' category by the QS World University Rankings. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has slipped in the rankings.
The institute has displayed a decreasing trend in the 'Southern Asia' category as compared to the ranking of preceding years. In 2026, BHU fell 6 ranks to #44 rank in the 'Southern Asia' category by the QS World University Rankings. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has slipped in the rankings.

individual_reviews.course: B.Com. in Corporate Secretaryship - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Everything is good in this college, so give it a try.

content.Placements: I've enrolled for Bachelor of Commerce specialisation in Corporate Secretaryship, and there are 26 members in our class. The highest package is Rs. 15,000 pm and the lowest is Rs. 10,000 p.m. Everyone in our class got internship placement, and we've trained in December 2024. Companies such as CIEL, FORTE MANAGEMENT, TECH MAHINDRA, VERTEX SOLUTIONS, JUST DIAL, MONEY PLUS have come to our college for placements.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Nursing - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Well, if you came only for study, it is good.

content.Placements: In our college, students are selected according to their percentage, which has to be more than 75%. And our college has a link with the government hospital in Kanchipuram; it's helpful for practicing. Apollo and Chettinadu Hospital came for placements. You will definitely get selected in any of the two hospitals.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are quite good with AV aids and the drinking water facility is good, but the toilet facility may be a bit disappointing. individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Review of Meenakshi Ammal Dental College and Hospital, MAHER.

content.Placements: I have been a dental student here at Meenakshi Ammal Dental College and Hospital for almost 4 years (My final year). We are a class of 90 students. The package given to interns is low, but the patient flow is good as it is situated in one of the main areas of the city.
content.Infrastructure: The lecture hall accommodates more than 100 students and has a theatrical pattern. The classroom is fully air-conditioned with a smartboard. It is bright with a good feeling of warmth. Meanwhile, the hostel and mess food are above average. Air-conditioned rooms are available. There are four hostels, 3 for girls and 1 for boys, 2 inside the campus and 2 outside the campus. Even though the campus is small, the facilities are not compromised. This helps in getting to know other batchmates and other students better. It is also an anti-ragging campus. The basketball court is at the centre, and the cricket nets are towards the right. There are trees in most places, and they have their own biological names. The mess has a fixed food schedule. The hostel rules are equal for both girls and boys. A large number of games are available, ranging from futsal to table tennis.

admission_process.title: Meenakshi Academy of Higher Education and Research Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: Meenakshi Academy of Higher Education and Research admission is open for all the courses. The university offers various UG, PG, and Diploma programmes specialised in Science, Commerce, and Business administration and others. The college conducted an online mode of application. Admission to all the courses is both merit entrance based. Applicants seeking admission to the university can apply online through the official website ofMeenakshi Academy of Higher Education and Research. To know more about the Meenakshi Academy of Higher Education and Research admission process along with course eligibility and selection criteria go through the below segments:

Meenakshi Academy of Higher Education and Research offers entrance and merit-based admission to all its courses. Admission to all UG, PG, and diploma courses is open. Candidates who fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria for the respective course will have to appear for the entrance exam for admission to BDS, MBBS, MDS, MS, and other courses. Step 2: MAHER Selection Process 2025

placement_data.title: Jamia Millia Islamia Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: The 2025 placement data has been released for MCA and MSc Bioinformatics. The highest salary offered to MCA and MSc Bioinformatics students during 2025 placements was INR 18.5 LPA and INR 6 LPA . The placement rate for MCA was 46% . The MCA average salary stood at INR 7.85 LPA . TCS, IBM, and Newgen were some of the renowned companies.

The University has released the annual report 2024 incorporating the 2024 placement stats. The highest salary offered to the 2024 batch was INR 59.91 LPA and was offered to BTech Computer Engineering students. For MBA, the highest salary stood at INR 24 LPA. The total number of students placed during Jamia Millia Islamia placements 2024 was 330. The number of BTech Electrical Engineering students placed was 54 . The highest and lowest salary offered to BTech EE students was INR 22 LPA and INR 2.2 LPA .
