reviews.review_heading: College is very good and the faculty is very helpful in every advice or term.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is pretty good. The Wi-Fi and the canteen food are also decent. Sports happen every month, and a lot of students participate in them. Prizes are also decent, like vouchers and electronic gadgets, which are very helpful for students and increase their productivity.

reviews.review_heading: Affordable and superb infrastructure college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is top-class. Although the area is not that big because of the Delhi location, the overall infrastructure is the best. Jamia has its sports complex where Ranji matches are also held, and all facilities are available. Hostel charges are about Rs. 40,000 per year, including mess and accommodation.

reviews.review_heading: It offers what a tier-3 college can provide and is good in terms of ROI.
reviews.review_text: The basic facilities such as smart boards, microphones and speakers, drinking water, and a girls' common room are available. The departmental library is well-equipped with resources and study materials. There are numerous canteens on campus that offer good food at reasonable prices. The campus is green and beautiful. Talking about the hostel, it has 3-seater rooms, a common room, a reading hall, clean drinking water, and average mess food available.

reviews.review_heading: Jamia Millia Islamia review
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course were extremely good. Wi-Fi facility was available. A central library was present. Classrooms were integrated with digital TV. The quality of the hostel was extremely good, but the hostel capacity was very less, so most students could not get hostel accommodation.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Jamia Millia Islamia.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course are good. Wi-Fi is available. Classrooms are good. A central library is present. The hostel quality and our faculty members are good. All essential facilities are available. Food and canteen food are good.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the overall experience, good environment, and decent infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are well maintained and have all the basic necessities like Wi-Fi and air-conditioned libraries. The campus has decent infrastructure. The washrooms are not that great and need regular cleaning. Classrooms are well-ventilated. The food quality in the mess and the canteen is average but eatable. Medical facilities are barely provided. There is a huge sports complex at gate number 3.

reviews.review_heading: It's a beautiful campus and a well-reputed university, and the teaching staff is great.
reviews.review_text: The hostel accommodation began by December, while I secured a seat in August itself. So it got a little difficult for me. The room is nice, spacious with a 3 seater, food was okay, we used to get veg and non-veg both. The quality was not great but decent. Seats are very much limited, this is one issue. The hostel is 1.5 km away from the college. Hostel fee is INR 48,000 per year. They need improvement in terms of class infrastructure, smart boards and projects are needed.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the quality of the course.
reviews.review_text: Our department is equipped with high-speed Wi-Fi, AC, a water purifier, and a projector. To conduct experiments, all necessary facilities are available in our lab, including RT-PCR, qPCR, BSL-2, a cell culture room, and a Virus culture lab. Our university has a central library near my department, where you can issue any two books for 14 days. The central canteen has good quality food at a cheap rate, and many other shops are also there. Cricket ground and other sports grounds are working, you ca...

reviews.review_heading: JMI: A central university in New Delhi.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. Classrooms have AC for 2nd year students onwards, and the seats are good. Sometimes issues are faced that are resolved within a few days. Wi-Fi is available. FET library is working from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM on weekdays. The central library in a block remains open from 9:00 AM-2:AM, except national holidays.

reviews.review_heading: Very good faculty and very nice experience.
reviews.review_text: There are six boys' hostels named F.R.K, A.P.J, B.R.A, A.M.K, Kelat, and S.R.K (Alma Iqbal is not available right now). The hostels and mess are very affordable, with hygienic and nutritious food. The engineering department has one big building with different sections for different departments. The library has AC and Wi-Fi connection.

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty, but 2024 was not a good year for engineering.
reviews.review_text: All five departments, Computer, Electronic, Electrical, Mechanical, and Civil, have a common building. There is one separate building for the library and reading room, fully air-conditioned with centralized Wi-Fi. Electrical Engineering classes have no AC. In Jamia, there are 7 boys' hostels and 3 girls' hostels. The mess is hygienic and very affordable. Hostel costs around Rs. 40,000 per year for mess and accommodation.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, everything is okay.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure are good. Department is also good. Wi-Fi is good. Classrooms are not too much good. Library is excellent. The food quality is not too much good in mess. Canteen food is good. Medical facilities are free which is good. Sports and games are also good.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied with placement but very good faculty.
reviews.review_text: The quality of mess food is good, especially in A.P.J. hostel and F.R.K. hostel. There are 3 girls' hostels and 6 or 7 boys' hostels, and there are many canteens in Jamia with affordable prices. Sports facilities are available, as well as a clinic. The engineering department has one building, and there is another building for the reading room and library.

reviews.review_heading: 2022 is the best year for electrical engineering.
reviews.review_text: The overall campus is good. The buildings are good, and the dentistry building is very nice, well-maintained, and well-designed. The engineering department has a personal library and reading room, and all 5 departments of engineering have a common building. There are a total of 6 boys' hostels and 3 girls' hostels. The mess is hygienic, and the food is decent at a reasonable price. Jamia has a sports complex and a free clinic for students.

reviews.review_heading: Development extension - Professional course.
reviews.review_text: All the students had access to Wi-Fi and library. Library at Jamia was very good, and the classrooms of the department were average. The hostel was very good. The quality of food was also good.

The NEET UG 2026 registration has started for admission to MBBS, BDS and other courses. The last date to register is Mar 8, 2026. Also, the NEET UG exam 2026 is going to be held on May 3, 2026.

Institute of Medical Sciences, BHU admission 2026 is open. Candidates can apply directly through the official website.

college_info.intro:
MBBS can be considered a popular program among many programmes that IMS BHU offers. It is offered at the UG- level for 100 students through full-time mode. The IMS BHU’s MBBS course was ranked 6 by India Today in the year 2021.
For the General category candidates,the minimum eligibility criteria is to obtain 50% in Class 12 in subjects Physics, Chemistry, Biology/Biotechnology, and English from a recognised board. 85% of the total seats are filled through state-level counselling and for the remaining seats, All India Centralised Counselling is conducted based on the NEET ranks obtained. For 5 years, a candidate is likely to spend INR 1.49 Lakh on tuition fees. As per the stats of placements, the median salary hikes to INR 15 Lakh. To know more about the programmes, refer to the table given below:

The recruiters for other courses at BHU include prominent names such as KPMG, Deloitte, SBI Life, Mphasis, Yes Bank, Indiamart, Accenture, Reliance, Genpact, IDFC First Bank, Wipro, Amazon, Havells, ICIC

faqs.answer: A:    The Institute of Medical Sciences (IMS) at Banaras Hindu University (BHU) in Varanasi, offers a Doctor of Medicine (MD) program in various specializations. IMS BHU is a very cost-effective college as it is a government college. This college is ranked 5th best college in terms of medical and 18th best in dental. For the course of Doctorate of Medicine [MD] INR 22,860 1st Year fees with eligibility - post graduation with a duration of 3 years so approximately would be near to 60 to 70 thousand.
faqs.question: What is the fee for MD at Institute of Medical Sciences, BHU?

faqs.answer: A:    Candidates who get selected to pursue a BSc in Nursing at the Institute of Medical Sciences, BHU must confirm their admission by submitting the applicable fees. The total tuition fee for a BSc at IMS BHU is INR 900. Furthermore, selected candidates must pay a one-time fee of INR 800 at admission. This includes Enrolment Fee, Admission Fee, I-Card and Passbook Fee, College Caution Money, and Degree Charges. The mentioned fee is sourced from the official website of the college/sanctioning body. It is still subject to change and, hence, is indicative.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent faculty and academic campus.
reviews.review_text: Facilities: 4/5 The facilities of dental science labs are well-equipped, with simulation clinics, and an OPD with good patient flow. Access to the broader infrastructure of IMS - BHU, including central labs, library, lecture hall, free Wi-Fi all around the campus, and many more free digital resources. Hostel facilities are adequate and secure, although some of the hostels are old and might need renovation. The central S. Hospital also provides interdisciplinary clinical exposure.

reviews.review_heading: College and campus are good, but it needs to provide M.Sc nursing for the future.
reviews.review_text: In this college, we get many facilities like Wi-Fi, library, labs, lecture theatre, and also the infrastructure is good. The hostel is only provided to girls. The food quality of the mess is good and affordable. Medical facilities are free for each student. A few canteens are also available. Our college also provides sports facilities and gives some certificates.

reviews.review_heading: BHU is a dream to many students and you will get many opportunities here for everything.
reviews.review_text: All facilities provided by the university like gym, swimming pools, library, and yoga center are common to all BHU students. Medical students have all IMS facilities. Hostel is only available for girls and there is no hostel for boys. Girls hostel mess charges Rs. 4,000 per month and the quality of food is average.

reviews.review_heading: It is value for money.
reviews.review_text: Top-class facilities are available in our universities. There is a bad furnace in the laboratory. Books are also available for students to take on for a particular and return on the given date. The quality of the hostel on our campus is amazing. The major staff members, wardens, and everyone care too much caring and are supportive. The food is awesome. Even the garden is also perfect.

reviews.review_heading: Life of a MBBS student at IMS BHU.
reviews.review_text: The whole campus has Wi-Fi and the hostels are renovated with all necessary facilities like geyser, CCTV, and 24X7 guard. The hostel food is good but the menu is fixed so you might get bored after a year. Our college has lots of grounds. Badminton and basketball courts are available. There is a swimming pool if you wish to learn swimming.

reviews.review_heading: Internal Review of IMS BHU.
reviews.review_text:
There's the facilities in the infrastructure of this college is well and good. The Laboratories and classrooms are well-equipped and can be compared with India's. Best medical colleges. Medical facilities, sports and games are also very good. You will really appreciate these things in this medical college
The food quality in mass and canteen Is as usual as other medical college and other canteens.

reviews.review_heading: One of the best colleges in medicine.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure in our college is brilliant. All departments have their own equipped labs and demonstration rooms, fully installed with AC and the best instruments. Each department has its own libraries, and we also have Asia's largest central library along with a cyber library. The mess and canteen are quite affordable, with enough cleanliness, and the food quality is above average.

reviews.review_heading: Institute of Medical Sciences BHU - A remarkable name in medical education.
reviews.review_text: The college is situated at the entrance of the university, surrounded by greenery and better infrastructure. The entire university campus is supplied with high-speed Wi-Fi, even in the corners of hostel rooms. We are provided with 2-seater rooms in the 1st year, 3-4 seater rooms in the 2nd year, and again 2-seater rooms in the 3rd year and final year. The mess is quite good, with a very affordable rate for food. We also have our own cyber library, which is open 24 hours for all with good securit...

reviews.review_heading: Dream college because it has internal PG Kota, best faculty, good infrastructure and a green campus.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure of IMF BHU are very good the classroom is digital and labs are very highly maintained and there is a centralised AC and Wi-Fi campus. The hostel rooms are very good with having a centralise Wi-Fi in the hostel and food is very good and the canteen is 24 hours open.

reviews.review_heading: IMS BHU provides a good opportunity for study and research.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure at IMS BHU is good, but it is not as good as AIIMS. Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus, and the college is air conditioned. However, the hostel mess and hostel are not as good as AIIMS, and there is no canteen on campus. Instead, the college provides a "chain ki tapri" (a tea shop).

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and well qualified faculty are available at this college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure available for the BDS at the IMS was very good. All the modern facilities were given to the students to improve their learning. Labs, libraries, canteens, Wi-Fi, hostels, etc. were available for the students. Sports facilities were available for the students. Various sports tournaments were organized at the college.

reviews.review_heading: Review of College of Nursing.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of our college includes 3 lecture halls and separate labs for each subject. The hostel facility is only provided for the girls inside the campus, but there is no hostel facility provided to the male students. This is an issue of concern, besides this, everything is good in the college.

reviews.review_heading: Review of B.Sc. Nursing from Banaras Hindu University, Varanasi.
reviews.review_text: The facilities of the college are awesome; the classroom is well maintained and equipped with modern audio-visual aids; wi-fi is also present; and it is also equipped with AC. The hostel is also just awesome. A hostel is like a flat and there is also free wi-fi all the time. The canteen is well maintained. Sports grounds are also present and every year, annual sports are held. All indoor and outdoor games are available.

reviews.review_heading: A grand campus with beautiful infrastructure and a treasure of learning.
reviews.review_text:
A very large central library and cyber library facility are provided. The whole campus has a high-speed Wi-Fi facility for students. The lecture theater infrastructure is very good and world-class, with both modern and traditional blackboard ways of teaching as options.
The first-year hostel is extremely good. But the 2nd-year hostel bathrooms don't have geyser facilities.

reviews.review_heading: It is one of the best colleges.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good. Our college is Wi-Fi enabled. Our college provides separate departments with their UG and PG clinics. The hostel facilities are good. Wi-Fi facility is available in the hostel. The food served in the good. Our college has a canteen. The canteen services are not available at night. They conduct sports events and leagues.

faqs.question: Q: Is NEET compulsory for BDS at Nair Hospital Dental College?

faqs.answer: There are several highlights in BDS admission to Nair Hospital Dental College. Firstly, candidates must appear in the Entrance Test (NEET) with National Eligibility and secure qualifying marks. After the release of NEET results, eligible candidates can attend counseling sessions conducted by the concerned state or central authorities. During the counselling, candidates get an opportunity to show their interest in Nair Hospital Dental College. Besides, candidates can get allotment in the college based on NEET score and availability of seats. Finally, successful candidates have to complete admission formalities including document verification and fee payment to confirm their enrollment in the BDS programme at Nair Hospital Dental College.
faqs.question: Q: What is the admission process for BDS in Nair Hospital Dental College?

faqs.answer: There are two kinds of course offered at the Nair Hospital Dental College, one being the Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS) & other one is Master of Dental Surgery (MDS)The tuition fees for the BDS programme to start in the first year would be INR 103,900. During a period of 5 years, dental students are offered training and graduate in dentistry. Besides the (NEET)National Eligibility cum Entry Test/the (MNEET) Maharashtra NEET, the college also takes other admission exams and specifies the cutoff ranks, which will determine the eligibility of a candidate. While the application deadline for BDS usually falls between 9th February and 16th March 2024, it varies widely from institution to institution and from one country to another.On the other hand, the Fees of the First year of MDS programme run under INR 112,200. It is a course that concentrates on specializing in different fields of dentistry, in which learning is done over a period of several years. Students who want to be MDS students should also follow the same deadlines for applications and likewise as required of the BDS program.
faqs.question: Q: How much does MDS at Nair Hospital Dental College cost?

faqs.answer: The tuition fee for MDS courses at Nair Hospital Dental College is INR 3.6 lakh. Keep in mind that this fee may or may not be the same for each specialisation of MDS offered by Nair Hospital Dental College. Candidates who wish to enroll in the MDS courses of Nair Hospital Dental College are advised to visit the official website and confirm all the tuition fee payable by them.

individual_reviews.course: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Happy with the education, good infrastructure, and helpful professors.

content.Placements: We are a batch of 75 students. The packages vary depending upon the future field you choose. A general dentist may earn around 12 LPA. The post-graduation has several specialty courses, namely Prosthodontics and Crown & Bridge, Periodontology, Dentistry and Endodontics, Orthodontics & Dentofacial Orthopedics, Oral Pathology & Microbiology, Pedodontics & Preventive Dentistry, Oral Medicine, and Radiology.
content.Infrastructure: A number of facilities are available, including AC classrooms and AC libraries. There is no college campus. There are good hostel facilities with daily cleaning. The food in the canteen is okay. No mess is available. There is no ground. Parking slots are in the basement. There are 2 buildings: one is hostel + college + hospital, the other is only college + hospital.

individual_reviews.course: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Nair Hospital Dental College.

content.Placements: Our college offers internships for the students with a stipend of 18k. Additionally, we provide externships for students from other colleges, giving them wide exposure to patients and boosting confidence. We also offer an HO ship in other medical colleges as this college is run by BMC.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is good compared to other government colleges. The library is available with all the required books. The hostel is also quite spacious and has good infrastructure. A canteen is available, and there are air-conditioned lecture halls.

individual_reviews.course: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Reviewing Nair Hospital Dental College.

content.Placements: There are no placements through the college but there is a position of house officer which is offered to the students based on their merit after internships. The college also offers an externship programme for students of other colleges who have completed their final year exams to complete their internship at Nair.
content.Infrastructure: Compared to the other government colleges, the facilities and infrastructure provided by the college and the hostel is one of the best having facilities like geysers, mess, study room, etc. The hostel provides a comfortable living. The college has a well-equipped library which is open till 8 in the night.

individual_reviews.course: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Best college where you can see a better version of yourself after passing out.

content.Placements: It's not exactly placement. It has a one year compulsory bond. Stipend Rs. 11000. It is the same for all interns. There are no such company who separately comes for recruitment. The college itself recruiters us. All students who pass final year BDS are selected for this bond. Top roles offered is dentist.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is not available for everyone. Only for staff. Classroom has 50 person capacity with projector and air conditioner and is well lit. Library is also air conditioned and all dentistry books are available to access. Hostel is not good at all. It has medium level of security but no specific mess and no canteen, medical facilities. It has gym but is not included in hostel fees.

individual_reviews.course: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: It is a good college with a subpar campus and hostel.

content.Placements: Placements are not much good here. However, the good thing about Nair is that you are sure to become a skilled doctor. You get to treat a variety of patients, and you become proficient in all the various techniques. If you get a postgraduate degree, you can surely try for a job as a bonded professor here.
content.Infrastructure: I would have given a high rating if the college had its own hostel. Currently, the students have been allotted a B.M.C building as a hostel which is not in the vicinity of the college. All other facilities are top-notch. The library and the classrooms are up to the mark, and the clinics are well maintained.

reviews.review_heading: Happy with the education, good infrastructure, and  helpful professors.
reviews.review_text: A number of facilities are available, including AC classrooms and AC libraries. There is no college campus. There are good hostel facilities with daily cleaning. The food in the canteen is okay. No mess is available. There is no ground. Parking slots are in the basement. There are 2 buildings: one is hostel + college + hospital, the other is only college + hospital.

reviews.review_heading: Nair Hospital Dental College.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is good compared to other government colleges. The library is available with all the required books. The hostel is also quite spacious and has good infrastructure. A canteen is available, and there are air-conditioned lecture halls.

reviews.review_heading: Reviewing Nair Hospital Dental College.
reviews.review_text: Compared to the other government colleges, the facilities and infrastructure provided by the college and the hostel is one of the best having facilities like geysers, mess, study room, etc. The hostel provides a comfortable living. The college has a well-equipped library which is open till 8 in the night.

reviews.review_heading: Best college where you can see a better version of yourself after passing out.
reviews.review_text:
Wi-Fi is not available for everyone. Only for staff.
Classroom has 50 person capacity with projector and air conditioner and is well lit. Library is also air conditioned and all dentistry books are available to access. Hostel is not good at all. It has medium level of security but no specific mess and no canteen, medical facilities. It has gym but is not included in hostel fees.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college with a subpar campus and hostel.
reviews.review_text: I would have given a high rating if the college had its own hostel. Currently, the students have been allotted a B.M.C building as a hostel which is not in the vicinity of the college. All other facilities are top-notch. The library and the classrooms are up to the mark, and the clinics are well maintained.

reviews.review_heading: It is one of the best dental colleges in the country.
reviews.review_text: Our college had a newly renovated library with a vast collection of books and journals. The library was air-conditioned. The mess was present in the hostel itself, serving a reasonable quality of food. The hostel was nearby and the building was relatively new. The only downside was the number of rooms to student ratio which leads to usually 2-3 students sharing.

reviews.review_heading: College review For nair dental college.
reviews.review_text: College building is currently redeveloping the infrastructure. There is no Wi-Fi connectivity. A very well-equipped library and well managed administration. There is a games room for recreational activities. Two common rooms, one each for boys and girls separately.

reviews_list.review_title: It is the best college in Maharashtra for dentistry.

review_content.Placements: I am an intern at Government Dental College And Hospital, Mumbai. Admissions to this college completely occur based on NEET UG exam score and their rank. Around 125 new students take admission every year. Interns get an Rs 11,000 stipend every month for 1 year. It is 5 years course which includes 4 years of academics, and a 1-year internship is compulsory.
review_content.Infrastructure: This college has 4-5 floor buildings with good infrastructure. Classrooms are clean and well-maintained. There are 8-9 departments in this college. It also provides a library which remains open from 8.00 AM to 10.00 PM. There is no mess system for hostelers, but two canteens are available i.e one is in the hostel, and another one is in the hospital which provides good quality food.

reviews_list.batch_info: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2017
reviews_list.review_title: Dentistry earns lot of money with respect to doctors but only after good practice.

review_content.Placements: All my colleagues and seniors of our college with good practical knowledge have excellent earnings. If you understand the basic funds and things in your clinic, then u do good practice and earn well. In our batch, out of 150 students, 95 students passed out in the first attempt. Many of my colleagues started private clinics immediately after the internship completion and made average earnings initially but now, after 3-4 years they earn well.
review_content.Infrastructure: The library in the ground floor has lots of important books available which is open at college time of 9 am to 5 pm. You need a library card to get book from the library temporarily and then return it. There are about 5000 books related to dental. There is peaceful environment in library for reading. There is a seperate reading room available with a chair and table. There is free Wi-Fi for staff and students. There is a huge garden on campus with trees for chilling after hospital closure. Problem in hostel is cleanliness. There is garbage all around.

individual_reviews.title: I am not satisfied with faculty members of this college.

content.Placements: In our college, around 95% is required in NEET for admission. Admission takes place through NEET counseling. individual_reviews.course: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: I would recommend students to join this college.

content.Placements: Our college was good for both under graduation and post-graduation. Internships were great at this college. The patient flow was around 250.
content.Infrastructure: The library was very good. Air-conditioners were available. Hostel facilities were better. The food served in the canteen was good. Our classrooms were well-maintained. Sports were conducted in our college. We can play basketball and table tennis.
content.Faculty: Our teachers were very good. They always help us with our doubts. Semester exams were moderate, and the pass percentage was 50%. Our teachers were helpful, and we can learn all the basics of dentistry like RCT and extraction.

individual_reviews.course: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: It is the best college in Maharashtra for dentistry.

content.Placements: I am an intern at Government Dental College And Hospital, Mumbai. Admissions to this college completely occur based on NEET UG exam score and their rank. Around 125 new students take admission every year. Interns get an Rs 11,000 stipend every month for 1 year. It is 5 years course which includes 4 years of academics, and a 1-year internship is compulsory.
content.Infrastructure: This college has 4-5 floor buildings with good infrastructure. Classrooms are clean and well-maintained. There are 8-9 departments in this college. It also provides a library which remains open from 8.00 AM to 10.00 PM. There is no mess system for hostelers, but two canteens are available i.e one is in the hostel, and another one is in the hospital which provides good quality food.

individual_reviews.course: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2017
individual_reviews.title: Dentistry earns lot of money with respect to doctors but only after good practice.

content.Placements: All my colleagues and seniors of our college with good practical knowledge have excellent earnings. If you understand the basic funds and things in your clinic, then u do good practice and earn well. In our batch, out of 150 students, 95 students passed out in the first attempt. Many of my colleagues started private clinics immediately after the internship completion and made average earnings initially but now, after 3-4 years they earn well.
content.Infrastructure: The library in the ground floor has lots of important books available which is open at college time of 9 am to 5 pm. You need a library card to get book from the library temporarily and then return it. There are about 5000 books related to dental. There is peaceful environment in library for reading. There is a seperate reading room available with a chair and table. There is free Wi-Fi for staff and students. There is a huge garden on campus with trees for chilling after hospital closure. Problem in hostel is cleanliness. There is garbage all around.

individual_reviews.course: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: It is a very good college for opting for a dental course.

content.Placements: The college offers a bachelor degree in dental and also a master in various fields of dentistry. There is no recruiting system as it is a medical college. Students have to find on their own in future to excel in life. As it a medical college, the students have to go through a one-year internship.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is good, but there is a slight shortage currently going with the materials for studying as it is a government-funded college. The mess is good, and the hostel is the best and has a great value for money. Classrooms, laboratories and the library are good, and our college has a separate gym for boys and girls. reviews_list.review_title: Mediocre because of no placements or internship opportunities, yet the infrastructure is very good.

review_content.Placements: Around 5-6 students enrolled in the year I took admission. Next year, there were 11-12 students who took admission. There are no placement opportunities or internships provided by our college, which is a huge satisfaction, given that we pay so many fees. There are no recruiting companies that come for placements.
review_content.Infrastructure: There's everything, the classrooms are very spacious, and there are smart boards, there's Wi-Fi, labs, and a library as well, which has plenty of books required for all the departments. The hostels are very clean and tidy. The food is very yummy and also hygienic. You can get all sorts of food, ranging from South Indian to North Indian and even snacks. There's a medical college and a hospital right next to our building, so medical help is always readily available. There are also sports tournaments and club activities that keep happening from time to time. The infrastructure and teaching quality are too good.

University hostel facilities in both the Peenya campus and the Gangotri campus had good rooms, and good food was provided there.

review_summary.college_name: MS Ramaiah University of Applied Sciences Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Discontinued(Dec 2025)- B.Sc. (Hons.) in Economics - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Mediocre because of no placements or internship opportunities, yet the infrastructure is very good.

content.Placements: Around 5-6 students enrolled in the year I took admission. Next year, there were 11-12 students who took admission. There are no placement opportunities or internships provided by our college, which is a huge satisfaction, given that we pay so many fees. There are no recruiting companies that come for placements.
content.Infrastructure: There's everything, the classrooms are very spacious, and there are smart boards, there's Wi-Fi, labs, and a library as well, which has plenty of books required for all the departments. The hostels are very clean and tidy. The food is very yummy and also hygienic. You can get all sorts of food, ranging from South Indian to North Indian and even snacks. There's a medical college and a hospital right next to our building, so medical help is always readily available. There are also sports tournaments and club activities that keep happening from time to time. The infrastructure and teaching quality are too good.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Honest review of my college.

content.Placements: We are still in our first year and are the followers of the pilot batch. We have heard companies such as AB and GE have come to place, and a few other industries located in Peenya, with packages of 2.5 to 5 LPA. ABB and GE are a few companies that have selected our seniors. We are still in our first year, so we have just heard it from our seniors. A few companies are giving a stipend of 8000.
content.Infrastructure: College food and mess are always pathetic. As per my friends who are staying in the hostel, they have reviewed it as good food in the hostel. However, the college canteen pricing was cheap, but the food quality was not up to the mark.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: MBA course information and admission process at Ramaiah University of Applied Science.

content.Placements: Approximately 85% of students are placed. The lowest package is 3 LPA, the highest reached 12 LPA, and the average hovered around 6 LPA. Deloitte, Infosys, TCS, and HDFC Bank are among the recruiters. Finance and consulting firms offered internships. There are fewer tier-1 roles, according to some students.
content.Infrastructure: The campus offers robust Wi-Fi, computer labs, smart classrooms, and a well-stocked library. The mess food is mediocre, but the hostel is respectable. There are some, but not many, sports and cultural facilities. Emergency medical care is subpar and could be better.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Automotive Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: M.Tech and B.Tech Automotive Engineering Course Admission.

content.Placements: Approximately 70-75% of the students are placed. The lowest package is 3 LPA, the highest is 12 LPA, and the average is about 5 LPA. Ashok Leyland, Bosch, Mahindra, and Tata Motors were among the top recruiters. Auto factories and R&D companies offered internships, but the core job roles were more restricted than those of IT-based profiles.
content.Infrastructure: Practical learning is supported by well-equipped labs, CAD/CAM facilities, and automotive workshops. Classrooms are large, and Wi-Fi is dependable. The mess food is mediocre, but the hostel is decent. There are some sports facilities, but not many. Although it could be more timely, medical care is adequate.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Computational Social Science - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied within a year with great facilities and good infrastructure.

content.Placements: A lot of roles are offered in very high-verified job sites, like the companies TCS, Infosys, IBM, Amazon, and also Google, with an average salary package depending on the department, but in a range of 4-7 LPA, with the highest domestic package reaching up to 52 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The food and infrastructure are top-notch, except for the Wi-Fi issues. I am not using any hostel right now, but based on what I heard, this is the thing they face; they have a proper curfew and good food, which properly provides the needed nutrients.

paragraphs: MSRUAS admission processconsists of multiple steps. It includes applying online to RUASAT for entrance-based admission or registering for direct admission. More details aroundM.S. Ramaiah University of Applied Sciences admission processare as follows:
Application Process

MSRUAS application process is conducted in online mode. Candidates can apply on the official website for their desired programme. An application fee of INR 2000 needs to be paid through online gateway.
Selection Process

Students are shortlisted based on entrance exams for all of the courses except for the BVoc programme. The university conducts RUAS-AT for admission to the remaining programmes. Alternatively, valid scores of other national-level exams including CUET/ NEET/ JEE or state-level exams - KCET/ COMEDK are also accepted,
Counselling Process & Document Verification

After the completion of all the selection rounds, candidates are offered seats through common counselling process. Candidates who get selected must download and fill an admission form on the university's official website. After filling the form, candidates need to pay a tuition fee and submit documents at the university for the verification.

MS Ramaiah University of Applied Sciences fee structuremay include components such as tuition fees, library fees, lab fees, caution deposit, etc. Some elements are to be paid only once, while the remaining are charged yearly or semesterly. The fee range includes multiple specialisations. The seat intake may change every academic year. reviews.review_heading: Mediocre because of no placements or internship opportunities, yet the infrastructure is very good.
reviews.review_text: There's everything, the classrooms are very spacious, and there are smart boards, there's Wi-Fi, labs, and a library as well, which has plenty of books required for all the departments. The hostels are very clean and tidy. The food is very yummy and also hygienic. You can get all sorts of food, ranging from South Indian to North Indian and even snacks. There's a medical college and a hospital right next to our building, so medical help is always readily available. There are also sports tournamen...

reviews.review_heading: Honest review of my college.
reviews.review_text: College food and mess are always pathetic. As per my friends who are staying in the hostel, they have reviewed it as good food in the hostel. However, the college canteen pricing was cheap, but the food quality was not up to the mark.

reviews.review_heading: MBA course information and admission process at Ramaiah University of Applied Science.
reviews.review_text: The campus offers robust Wi-Fi, computer labs, smart classrooms, and a well-stocked library. The mess food is mediocre, but the hostel is respectable. There are some, but not many, sports and cultural facilities. Emergency medical care is subpar and could be better.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by Faculty of Engineering and Technology, M.S. Ramaiah University of Applied SciencesReviewed on 22 Aug 2025)
reviews.review_heading: M.Tech and B.Tech Automotive Engineering Course Admission.
reviews.review_text: Practical learning is supported by well-equipped labs, CAD/CAM facilities, and automotive workshops. Classrooms are large, and Wi-Fi is dependable. The mess food is mediocre, but the hostel is decent. There are some sports facilities, but not many. Although it could be more timely, medical care is adequate.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied within a year with great facilities and good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The food and infrastructure are top-notch, except for the Wi-Fi issues. I am not using any hostel right now, but based on what I heard, this is the thing they face; they have a proper curfew and good food, which properly provides the needed nutrients.

reviews.review_heading: My honest review of my college.
reviews.review_text: The hostel was well-equipped with all major facilities such as Wi-Fi, showers, etc. Shared rooms were available (2 in 1 room). Each room had a chair and study table for each student, along with separate cupboards. The fees were  Rs.45,000 per year, and the mess fees were around Rs.4,000 a month. The food quality was a total disaster. My advice would be to take a flat outside the campus and have good food. University hostel facilities in both the Peenya campus and the Gangotri campus had good roo...

reviews.review_heading: My honest review of my college.
reviews.review_text: Hostels provided single and shared rooms, with prices ranging from Rs.35,000 to Rs.60,000 per room, including electricity charges. Food was not included.

reviews.review_heading: My review about this college.
reviews.review_text: Hostel rooms were good as my friend resides in the hostel. I used to go to his room in my free time. Room was shared as 2 students were residing in a room. There were separate things for both students in a room like a wardrobe, bed, table, and 2 chairs. College had PG named 555-PG. Mess fee was Rs 4,000 for every month which included breakfast, lunch, snacks, and dinner.

reviews.review_heading: My review about this college.
reviews.review_text: It's good as it has a hostel inside the college with all live home facilities where it's been provided with a gym, yoga, sports room, club room, and party room. Each room is provided with a self-system for the students living for their usage, food is good and they provide to your room 3 times a day. This course is meant for me to join the top companies in which the Ramaiah has been liked with that companies and they are giving very good facilities to the students. My dream is to become a very go...

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Faculty of Engineering and Technology, M.S. Ramaiah University of Applied SciencesReviewed on 13 May 2025)
reviews.review_heading: It has an environment to find minded people and grow with part of difficulties and blockades.
reviews.review_text: We have special rooms for boys and girls known as a sac with an in-built gym and other board games as well. There is a ground for football, cricket, and indoor courts as well. The hostel is average with okay food. It has a 3-star hostel. Timings are preferred for students.

reviews.review_heading: There are no placements yet by the college, but it's a great experience to learn the course.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is really good, with classrooms, places to eat, and good sanitation practices. Labs are well-equipped, and classrooms have interactive boards to help us with our academics and course understanding. There is a huge park, wide corridors, a huge food street, and good parking facilities.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2021Offered by M S Ramaiah Medical CollegeReviewed on 24 Mar 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Future leaders from MS Ramaiah Medical College.
reviews.review_text: The college campus is present within the MS Ramaiah Medical Hospital. There are 1300+ special beds available for explaining practical cases to students. The campus area is expansive and broad, and it is quite peaceful, amazing, and relaxing.

reviews.review_heading: A brief review of Ramaih College of Pharmacy.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is the main highlight of the college. The campus is vast comprising 13 different faculty members like engineering, medical, dental, etc. Wi-Fi is available throughout the college, labs are equipped with all the necessary instruments and chemicals. Classes are high-teach comprising smartboard speakers, and comfortable seats for individual students. The library is on the third floor where all the required books are available we can get them for 3 or 15 days. The hostel i...

reviews.review_heading: A college that everyone should check out. It has a really good faculty and a big, beautiful campus.
reviews.review_text: Facilities wise, it is really great. Classrooms have Wi-Fi, and each table has separate charging ports for laptops or mobile phones. There are projectors, speakers, and more. The campus has a vast library, places to relax, an indoor sports complex, and other amenities. The quality of the hostel is good, and more hostels are being built. The food is also good and of high quality.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members are good overall.
reviews.review_text: We have one lab but 2-3 batches have lab classes at the same time. We have to find some other classrooms which are empty for the lab. The hostel is too bad. The food is not bad and many get food poisoning. Water is also not good and it is not purified. The bathing water is in yellow or brown colors a few times.

fees_and_eligibility.overview: Overview not available

reviews_list.batch_info: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: Director doesn't do his job. He is not at all cooperative.

review_content.Placements: In medical colleges, placement is 100%. The highest monthly salary is above Rs. 1 lac initially, but later, one can earn unlimited income. No companies come to recruit. Every student does an internship in our college. Top roles depend on the job the student is doing.
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure: everything is there but not very well-renovated. The hostel is good to stay in. The mess food is not up to the mark. But the only problem is that the room's windows are only for one person; the other person can't get any access to the windows. I need additional supplements to survive. The food is dipped in oil. Vegetables are fried to a crisp.

reviews_list.batch_info: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2016
reviews_list.review_title: It is the best college in our state for our course.

review_content.Placements: The college doesn't provide any placements. However, we can join the other colleges of the same rank after the course. But if we look into placements provided by the college, then it is disappointing as they don't have such provision for this course.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is amazing. The library and classrooms are well-equipped. The campus provides everything. Gymnasium and swimming pool are excellent. Hospital is extremely functional and has great emergency handling capacities. The campus is enabled with Wi-Fi.

reviews_list.batch_info: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2019
reviews_list.review_title: An insight into KALINGA INSTITUTE OF DENTAL Science.

review_content.Placements: The BDS course doesn't offer placements like engineering, MBA and other courses. However, they provide paid rotatory internship (which is a part of the 5 year course programme). The stipend is amongst the highest offered in indian dental colleges. Also the patient flow is satisfactory.
review_content.Infrastructure: There are 9 well-equipped and fully functional departments. Others: 6 air conditioned lecture theatres, Phantom lab (preclinical conservative lab), Preclinical prosthodontics lab and an air conditioned auditorium with a seating capacity of 300 approximately. Air conditioned library is also there.

reviews_list.batch_info: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2022
reviews_list.review_title: Kalinga institute of dental science is a heaven for students who want both academics and social life

review_content.Placements: Medical and dental colleges are professional colleges so there is no tension of placement. Placement is good. Your future is settled. You can work with senior doctors after completing internship. You can prepare for MS side by side. After completing BDS you can work for any hospital or open clinic. You can start preparing for MS if you want to get into teaching line and become a professor. BDS degree has many scopes. Jobs just after completing BDS will carry packages of approximately 10 to 15 thousands per month. It will increase as your experience increases.

reviews_list.batch_info: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2019
reviews_list.review_title: The campus is good. Faculty members are good. Good infrastructure. Moderate patient flow.

review_content.Placements: There is no placement as it's a dental college, and since it is a part of medical college, according to DCI, it has the internship programme for 1 year. Since it's a medical college, placements are not currently present. I do hope that the medical boards someday would put placements in medical and dental colleges.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is good. The college has good equipment and offers a good background to deal with a patient, but lacks in providing materials required while doing work with a patient. Otherwise, the infrastructure is overall good with a moderate patient flow in the hospital.

reviews_list.batch_info: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2020
reviews_list.review_title: Absolutely satisfied with its faculty, superb infrastructure and facilities.

review_content.Placements: There will be a superb placement here, according to your result as it deals with the medical subjects. The salary for the internship is Rs. 10,000 per month. Also, everyone got the internship in this college itself as one has to do the internship here only and the stipend was Rs. 10,000, which is very useful and I love it a lot.
review_content.Infrastructure: It has the best infrastructure, and I loved to go to the classes. It has a Wi-Fi available for each student individually. They also have labs for each ward. It also has AC lecture theatres and an AC library. It also has sports room. The food in the canteen is also great. Also, the hostel rooms are good and are double seated. I love it.

reviews.review_heading: Director doesn't do his job. He is not at all cooperative.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure: everything is there but not very well-renovated. The hostel is good to stay in. The mess food is not up to the mark. But the only problem is that the room's windows are only for one person; the other person can't get any access to the windows. I need additional supplements to survive. The food is dipped in oil. Vegetables are fried to a crisp.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college in our state for our course.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is amazing. The library and classrooms are well-equipped. The campus provides everything. Gymnasium and swimming pool are excellent. Hospital is extremely functional and has great emergency handling capacities. The campus is enabled with Wi-Fi.

reviews.review_heading: An insight into KALINGA INSTITUTE OF DENTAL Science.
reviews.review_text:
There are 9 well-equipped and fully functional departments. Others:
6 air conditioned lecture theatres, Phantom lab (preclinical conservative lab), Preclinical prosthodontics lab and an air conditioned auditorium with a seating capacity of 300 approximately. Air conditioned library is also there.

reviews.review_heading: Kalinga institute of dental science is a heaven for students who want both academics and social life
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. This is a DCI approved college. Library is there with books on different subjects. Classrooms are good in condition. Quality of food is great. Hostel rooms are good. Boys hostels are known as King's palace and girls' hostel are known as Queens Castle.

reviews.review_heading: The campus is good. Faculty members are good. Good infrastructure. Moderate patient flow.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. The college has good equipment and offers a good background to deal with a patient, but lacks in providing materials required while doing work with a patient. Otherwise, the infrastructure is overall good with a moderate patient flow in the hospital.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with its faculty, superb infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: It has the best infrastructure, and I loved to go to the classes. It has a Wi-Fi available for each student individually. They also have labs for each ward. It also has AC lecture theatres and an AC library. It also has sports room. The food in the canteen is also great. Also, the hostel rooms are good and are double seated. I love it.

reviews.review_heading: Greatly satisfied. Teachers, facilities and infrastructure are super.
reviews.review_text: I guess KIIT has the best campus. It is just superb. We have wards where we practice. We have good PRR Clinical labs. The lecture theatres are spacious and air-conditioned. We have medical facilities. The food available in the food courts is good enough. The hostel rooms are great. Everybody knows about the fests at KIIT. They are very famous.

reviews.review_heading: My college Kalinga institute of dental sciences.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is very good. The nine departments in the college are very big and well maintained. The building is well equipped with fire extinguisher. Each department has their OPD. The library is well organised and equipped with centralised air-conditioning and a digital library. The facilities like computer and Wi-Fi are provided.

reviews.review_heading: A mixed bag of feelings but a complete learning experience.
reviews.review_text: Well, here is where being associated with the prestigious KIIT University comes into play. We have one of the best infrastructures in terms of quality and quantity. We have big lecture halls that can easily accommodate 150+ students. Labs and equipment, though sometimes faulty, are up to date and repaired as soon as something goes wrong. A library is also attached with this college which houses an ample number of books and journals. A small canteen is also attached to the college premises which ...

reviews.review_heading: The college provides good education and fun.
reviews.review_text: The college has a good building with 4 blocks, 8 dental departments, 8 medical departments, separate hostels for girls and boys, sports room, two playgrounds, canteen and mess. There are also 4 lecture halls, two seminar halls, preclinical labs, biochem laps, physio labs and anatomy lab.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of the faculty, superb infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Its has the best infrastructure. I love to go to classes. It has Wi-Fi available for each student individually. They have labs for each ward. It has AC lecture theatres. Has AC library. Its has a sports room. Food is great in the canteen. Hostel rooms are good and are double-seated.

paragraphs: AMU Engineering and Management NIRF reports 2024, reports that the median package given to AMU BTech placements 2023 was INR 6 LPA , and for the MBA placements 2023, the median package stood at INR 5.26 LPA. With this the placement rate during Aligarh Muslim University placements 2023 for BTech was 82% and for MBA it was 84% .

Earlier, as per the media report, 5 students from the Faculties of Science, Life Science, Commerce and Engineering , Aligarh Muslim University (AMU) were selected by IB Global Academy , Gurugram as faculty members in the campus placement drive 2023. The highest package offered during AMU MBA placements 2023 stood at INR 14 LPA. Earlier, according to media reports, 11 BTech students have been placed during AMU placements 2022. Further, the highest package offered during AMU BTech placements 2022 stood at INR 21 LPA. The top recruiters of Aligarh Muslim University in 2022 included leading companies such as Forbes Marshall, Publicis Sapient, and Ramboll India.

nirf.description:
Based on the rankings from NIRF, AMU outperformed numerous other institutes, securing a higher position, indicating that the institute is considered to be doing better in various factors evaluated by the NIRF ranking system. In the 'Overall' category, the institute's ranks have displayed instability in comparison with last year's ranking. In 2025, AMU fell 3 ranks to #19 rank in the 'Overall' category by the NIRF ranking. Throughout the preceding two years, the rank has oscillated but is currently stable.
It has been observed that the institute has displayed a fluctuating trend in the 'University' category as compared to the ranking of preceding years. In 2025, AMU fell 2 ranks to #10 rank in the 'University' category by the NIRF ranking.
In the 'Engineering' category, the institute's ranks have descended when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2025, AMU fell 1 rank to #34 rank in the 'Engineering' category by the NIRF ranking. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has slipped in the rankings.
The institute's ranks in the 'Management' category; have shown a fluctuation when evaluated against previous year's ranking. In 2025, AMU climbed 1 rank to #69 rank in the 'Management' category by the NIRF ranking.
Discover the latest rankings and categories provided by other ranking bodies listed below.

outlook.description:
AMU has received strong ranks by the Outlook-ICARE under the 'Medical (Government)' category. Provided parameters including, Teaching, Graduation Outcome, Inclusivity and Research, the institute is ranked in a good position as compared to other institutes by the Outlook-ICARE 2025.
It has been seen that in the 'Arts' category, the institute's ranking has steadiness when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2025, AMU's rank is #50, the same as last year's rank in the 'Arts' category by the Outlook-ICARE ranking.
The institute has displayed stability in trend in the 'Social work' category when compared with the ranking of preceding years. In 2025, AMU's rank is #12, the same as last year's rank in the 'Social work' category by the Outlook-ICARE ranking.

qs_world.description:
As per the overall score, AMU has been placed at a good position by the QS World University Rankings under the 'Top Global Universities' category, reflecting its exceptional performance in areas like Teaching, Research, Graduation Outcomes, and creating an inclusive, quality learning environment. When compared to the ranking from the previous years, it has been seen that in the 'Top Global Universities' category, the institute's ranks have shown stability in trend. In 2026, AMU's rank is #1001, the same as last year's rank in the 'Top Global Universities' category by the QS World University Rankings.
One can observe that within the category of 'Asia', the institute's ranking has fluctuation when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2026, AMU's rank is #278, the same as last year's rank in the 'Asia' category by the QS World University Rankings.
The institute has displayed an increasing trend in the 'Southern Asia' category as compared to the ranking of preceding years. In 2026, AMU climbed 2 ranks to #62 rank in the 'Southern Asia' category by the QS World University Rankings. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has ascended in the rankings.

library.description:
The Central Library of the Aligarh Muslim University, Maulana Azad Library is one of the largest university libraries of the world which provides access to about 18,00,000 volumes of books, 60,000 plus current journals and about 20,00,000 research papers in hard and soft copies. In addition, there are over 100 sister libraries (college/seminar libraries). The  Library of Z. H. College of Engineering and Technology, is one of them. It is the second largest library of the University.
The Library of Z. H. College of Engineering and Technology, was established in 1938 with only 300 books and the number has gone over 1,75,000. In the last three years, 21,915 number of books have been added; number of additions in February 2016 alone is 204.

reviews.review_heading: This is the cheapest College of India.
reviews.review_text: The campus was full of greenery, facilities were good, many canteens were present with very good taste, multiple mosques were also available on campus, hostel quality was average. A badminton court was present in the hostel, a big sports complex was present in the college campus, and a large central library was present.

reviews.review_heading: Aligarh Muslim University better but not best.
reviews.review_text: At Aligarh Muslim University, students are provided free Wi-Fi and free library access for registered students. In the 1st year, there is no room available in the hostel. In 2nd or 3rd year, students are allotted a 4-seater room in good condition. Sports and canteen facilities are provided by the university.

reviews.review_heading: Review of my experience in this college.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure was very nice. Classrooms were clean and spacious. The library had sufficient books and study material available. Labs were properly equipped hain. Hostel facilities were good too, rooms are clean, and water, electricity and security arrangements were proper. Food quality was also ok.

reviews.review_heading: Good college with good infrastructure and facilities of AMU.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure of the college are good enough. Classrooms also have smart boards. Labs are fully working, and everything needed for experiments or project work is available. Wi-Fi works properly with high speed in hostels, but is a little weak in college. The college has its own book bank where students can take books and read in the reading lawn. Reading rooms are also available in all hostels. reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by Zakir Husain College of Engineering and Technology, Aligarh Muslim UniversityReviewed on 22 Nov 2025)
reviews.review_heading: A good college with decent placements and nominal fees.
reviews.review_text: The campus is equipped with full network Wi-Fi coverage, and it is very widespread. The classrooms are equipped with high-quality labs. The hostels are very good and large in size, and are based on an old style. We have various games to play, like table tennis, chess, carrom, hockey, cricket, football, and there is a swimming pool in which we can dive.

reviews.review_heading: The environment and academics are excellent, but placement is dissatisfying.
reviews.review_text:
Infrastructure is fantastic, as it is culturally rich, and the environment of the college is fabulous. But something which is a little disappointing is that the conditions of the hostel are very old and it needs modification, although modification and preparations takes place from time to time. Wi-Fi is available all across the campus. Food is affordable and hygienic.
The library is functional for 18 hours, and one of the biggest libraries in Asian under a university is present here.

reviews.review_heading: Great university with job opportunities.
reviews.review_text: Our course is best. Infrastructure of our university is excellent with greenery park and hostel facilities are too good, like food servicing, cleanliness, and rooms are with large space and personal cupboards. individual_reviews.course: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Really good college for medical students.

content.Placements: In my class, there are 100 students. The highest package is 12 Lacs, 15 Lacs, and 20 Lacs. I think more than 70% got internships. Many students are now faculty at our college, while some are working or studying abroad. I believe this is the best course for students.
content.Infrastructure: We have both digital and manual libraries, which are very useful for students and staff. Wi-Fi is provided for students, with 5 GB per day for each student. We can connect to Wi-Fi anywhere on campus and in the hostels. The hostel facilities are good, neat, and clean. Indoor and outdoor games are available for students.

individual_reviews.course: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied with the college, really good infrastructure and facilities.

content.Placements: 100 students are placed in the BDS course. The highest package is about 20 Lacs, and the average package is about 12 Lacs over 5 years. The top roles offered in our course require us to complete the Undergraduate BDS course, after which we should write NEET PG to get into any specialized field.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available in the department are the best. We get free Wi-Fi for the entire 5 years of the course, and we have access to many books in the library. The quality of food available in the canteen is very good, and the medical facilities are excellent.

individual_reviews.course: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Asmas experience at YDC Really satisfied by the campus and staffs .

content.Placements: Every year, 100 students get into internship courses. Internship is the fifth and final year of BDS. We're given a stipend. We have to work on patients during the internship. After that, students graduate as doctors from Yenepoya Dental College and Hospital (YDCH).
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is really good. There are big classrooms, laboratories, Wi-Fi, and a central library. We have a soccer ground and a gym. The central library has all kinds of books and journals. The hostel campus is garden-like. Food in the mess is good, and we’re provided with both vegetarian and non-vegetarian options.

individual_reviews.course: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Best Dental college in deemed sector .

content.Placements: 100 students are there in each batch. My feel is a twelve LPA package with a scholarship from NEET Excellence. The average package is twenty LPA. Also, a 15 LPA package exists. Everyone is required to do an internship as it's compulsory from IDA. The role is Doctor or Dentist.
content.Infrastructure: Quality is very good in college. Also, the quality of service is excellent in the hostel. Medical facilities are free, as it’s a hospital-based college. The library is the main highlight with up to 12 AM study facilities. Classrooms are digitalized with air conditioning and Wi-Fi facilities.

individual_reviews.course: BDS - Bachelor of Dental Surgery - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely loved this college and all these years of college life. The infrastructure is beautiful.

content.Placements: 100 students in each batch. Students who secured above 80% in 12th get a package of 3 Lacs per year, and if they've scored below 80%, they get 4 Lacs per year. The course is for a total of 5 years. Internships are provided within the university, where we have to do 1 year of community service. Placements are available through the alumni association abroad as well.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is massive, filled with greenery and mountains. They have cutting-edge technology that makes studying easier for students. The gallery-designed classrooms are well-equipped. The hostel is good, providing everything required by the students. The mess is excellent, with their own catering and bakery.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS) - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: A good dental college to join.

review_content.Placements: It is a professional college. So the students can expect to be well trained enough to start a clinic. The internship training in the college is also good. reviews_list.review_title: Good value for the money we pay.

faqs.answer: MRIIRS admissions are based on both merit and entrance based criteria. Students can visit the official website of the university and find out more about the eligibility details for their chosen course. Students can choose to apply directly on the basis of their merit scoring in the previous qualifying exam. For the majority of the programs, students can apply on the basis of prescribed entrance tests such as JEE Mains, SAT, Pearson, MRNAT, CUET, XAT, CAT, among others.
faqs.question: Q: Can I get direct admission in MRIIRS Faridabad?

faqs.answer: The MBA admissions at Manav Rachna International Institute of Research and Studies is based on various selection patterns. For details, students can check the points mentioned below:Marks in Class 10 and 12 : 10% weight ageMarks in Qualifying Examination (Graduation): 10% weight age.Marks / Percentile Score in the Entrance Examinations namely CAT / MAT / ATMA / JMET / SNAP / XAT / MR-NAT/MR-MAT: 25% weight age.Group Discussions: 10 % weight agePersonal Interview: 20% weight age.Behavioral skill test 10% weight ageWork Experience/ Extra- curricular achievements: 5% weight age
faqs.question: Q: What is the admission process for MBA at Manav Rachna International Institute of Research and Studies?

faqs.answer: MRIIRS Faridabad admissions begin with registration. Below are the step-wise admission process:Step One: Submission of Online ApplicationVisit the official website which is manavrachna.edu.in/mriirsStep Two: Uploading DocumentsAspirants need to upload a Class 12 mark sheet, a Valid Score of JEE Mains/ GATE, SAT/UNIGAUGE (if appeared), a Valid score of CLAT, Pre-final Year Mark sheets of higher education qualification (For PG Program).Step Three: Selection of Candidate and Offer of Admission LetterMerit Defining Document: Admission to various programs is based on merit as specified in Admission Brochure. Admissions to all programs are also made based on Manav Rachna National Aptitude Test (MRNAT) for which the scores shall automatically be picked up for merit.Step Four: Accepted of Admission and Payment of FeeAll the selected candidates for admission at Manav Rachna International Institute of Research and Studies, who receive Admission Offer Letter from the University shall be required to send the Acceptance of Admission for the offered programme in the format which shall be sent by the University Authority along with the Admission Offer Letter.Thereafter, the candidate shall be required to deposit the first installment of fee for various programmes within one week of offer of admission by using any mode as mentioned below (after Step-five).Step Five: Physical Verification of Documents and Enrollment ProcessAll the candidates, who have accepted the admission after receipt of Admission Offer Letter, shall be required to report at designated venue’s for “Physical Document Verification / Enrollment Process” as per the slots are given to them. Aspirants are required to bring Letter of ‘Offer of Admission’ and all the original fee receipts.

overview_faqs.question: What is the hostel fee of Manav Rachna International Institute of Research & Studies?
overview_faqs.answer: The hostel fee will cost approximate 1.5 Lacs at Manav Rachna International Institute of Research & Studies for a year including hostel and mess charges. There is an option for you to choose AC or non-AC rooms.

overview_faqs.question: Is Manav Rachna International Institute of Research & Studies under CUET?
overview_faqs.answer: No, Manav Rachna International Institute of Research & Studies is not under CUET. CUET, which stands for Central Universities Common Entrance Test, is a national entrance test administered by the NTA for MCA/Msc programs, but it does not include Manav Rachna International Institute of Research & Studies in its scope.

overview_faqs.question: Is Manav Rachna International Institute of Research and Studies approved?
overview_faqs.answer: Manav Rachna International Institute of Research and Studies is approved by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) and is recognised by the University Grants Commission (UGC). The university is also accredited by NAAC with A+ grade. Further, it has been conferred with 5-star rating for Teaching, Employability, Academic Development, Facilities, Social Responsibility, and Inclusiveness by the QS Rating System.

paragraphs: Manav Rachna International Institute of Research and Studiesadmits students based on various national-level entrance exams such as JEE Mains 2025/ SAT / Pearson / MRNAT 2025, CUET, XAT, CAT etc. The mode of application at Manav Rachna International Institute of Research and Studies is online.

The institute offers a range of undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral courses in Engineering, Business and Management Studies, Accounting, and Commerce among others. Popular courses offered by the university are MCA, BCA, MBA, BTech and BBA. MRIIRS Faridabad also offers multiple scholarships to support meritorious students and provide financial aid. Read on to know more aboutManav Rachna International Institute of Research and Studies course admissions2025.

The university offers courses in full-time mode over 20 courses. The admission process in 2025 is divided into five steps. Students can check the detailed points mentioned below:
Step One: Submission of Online Application
Visit the official website which is https://manavrachna.edu.in/mriirs
Step Two: Uploading Documents

Aspirants need to upload a Class 12 mark sheet, a Valid Score of JEE Mains/ GATE, SAT/UNIGAUGE (if appeared), a Valid score of CLAT, Pre-final Year Mark sheets of higher education qualification (For PG Program).
Step Three: Selection of Candidate and Offer of Admission Letter

Merit Defining Document: Admission to various programs is based on merit as specified in Admission Brochure. Admissions to all programs are also made based on Manav Rachna National Aptitude Test (MRNAT) for which the scores shall automatically be picked up for merit.
Step Four: Accepted of Admission and Payment of Fee

All the selected candidates for admission at Manav Rachna International Institute of Research and Studies, who receive Admission Offer Letter from the University shall be required to send the Acceptance of Admission for the offered programme in the format which shall be sent by the University Authority along with the Admission Offer Letter.

Thereafter, the candidate shall be required to deposit the first installment of fee for various programmes within one week of offer of admission by using any mode as mentioned below (after Step-five).
Step Five: Physical Verification of Documents and Enrollment Process

All the candidates, who have accepted the admission after receipt of Admission Offer Letter, shall be required to report at designated venue’s for “Physical Document Verification / Enrollment Process” as per the slots are given to them. Aspirants are required to bring Letter of ‘Offer of Admission’ and all the original fee receipts.

faqs.answer: DMIHER Online’s courses are relatively affordable. The MBA programme is offered by DMIMS through its affiliated institute Datta Meghe Institute of Higher Education and Research (DMIHER), which is available online. The fee for the MBA will be around Rs. 2,20,000 per annum, which is low compared to other colleges in the vicinity. The college may also charge a registration fee of Rs. 5,000. nirf.description:
Based on the rankings from NIRF, DMIHER outperformed numerous other institutes, securing a higher position, indicating that the institute is considered to be doing better in various factors evaluated by the NIRF ranking system. In the 'Overall' category, the institute's ranks have displayed instability in comparison with last year's ranking. In 2025, DMIHER fell 13 ranks to #84 rank in the 'Overall' category by the NIRF ranking.
It has been observed that the institute has displayed a decreasing trend in the 'University' category as compared to the ranking of preceding years. In 2025, DMIHER fell 7 ranks to #49 rank in the 'University' category by the NIRF ranking. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has slipped in the rankings.
In the 'Medical' category, the institute's ranks have ascended when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2025, DMIHER climbed 3 ranks to #20 rank in the 'Medical' category by the NIRF ranking. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has ascended in the rankings.
The institute's ranks in the 'Dental' category; have descended when evaluated against previous year's ranking. In 2025, DMIHER fell 12 ranks to #36 rank in the 'Dental' category by the NIRF ranking. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has slipped in the rankings.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied because of good teaching infrastructure, work, course.
reviews.review_text: This college has well-air-conditioned classrooms, labs, a great library, etc. In the hostel, the food is good & the rooms are much more comfortable, we have an indoor game room, tv room, study hall, and gym. And good medical facilities. There is much safety.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college for BDS and a hospital.
reviews.review_text: The surroundings of the college are pretty great, it has everything in its locality. There is a gym, restaurant, hotels, turf, Game Centre, cafes and a lot of exploring options around the college. I stayed in the hostel for 3 years. They only have a very limited number of AC rooms. And you cannot get a single room. The food quality is terrible. There are many departments like the pharmacology department, pathology department, biochemistry department, microbiology depth, moral pathology departmen...

reviews.review_heading: Review of SRM Dental College, Chennai.
reviews.review_text: Our college has the best library in Chennai, which consists of all the old and new books. Classrooms are spacious, and all the lecture halls are smart. The hostel is not up to the mark, and the food served will be pathetic.

reviews.review_heading: Review of SRM Kattankulathur Dental College and Hospital University Main Campus.
reviews.review_text: Our college provided excellent facilities. A library was available. A good collection of books was available in the library. Wi-Fi was available throughout the campus. Medical and canteen facilities were available. Hostels were separate for girls and boys. The hostel had good atmosphere. The warden was good, and safety was assured.

reviews.review_heading: I'm proud be a part of SRM.
reviews.review_text: Our college is very good. The infrastructure of our college is excellent. Our department and hostel have free Wi-Fi. The classrooms are very good. The hostel rooms are very good. There is a gym, TV hall, indoor games, separate study rooms, and a mess. The food is good, and there are only 2-3 dishes. Students from different states come here.

faculty_reviews.verified_reviews_info: The Verified badge indicates that the reviewer's details have been verified by Shiksha, and reviewers are bona fide students of this college. These reviews and ratings have been given by students. Shiksha does not endorse the same. Out of 9 published reviews , 7 reviews are verified.
